Method: 提出RollVerify，一个基于部分rollout的轻量RL框架，在样本进入训练前主动验证与修复。引入off-policy偏移度量OPS，量化部分生成轨迹的off-policy偏差；在OPS约束引导下，执行序列级和token级验证，识别并截断轨迹中无效的后缀，从而产出高质量样本。

Result: 在数学推理与工具辅助数学推理任务上，RollVerify在降低训练成本的同时取得与on-policy训练相当的精度；代码生成任务的额外结果提供了超越数学领域的初步证据。

Conclusion: 相比被动重加权，主动验证修复样本的策略可在保留部分rollout效率增益的同时保护模型精度，为可扩展RL训练提供有效方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is crucial for improving large language models' reasoning and generalization. It relies on massive rollouts whose lengths become increasingly long-tailed as context windows grow. In on-policy training, these long-tail rollouts can result in GPU bubbles, reducing system utilization and limiting RL scalability. Asynchronous or partial-rollout methods improve throughput by relaxing synchronization, but inevitably introduce stale off-policy samples (trajectories) that may hurt final accuracy. Existing approaches mainly mitigate this off-policy issue by reweighting off-policy samples during training, yet they can still leave a performance gap compared to fully on-policy training. In this work, rather than passively reweighting samples during training, we propose RollVerify, a lightweight RL framework built on partial rollout that actively verifies and repairs samples before they enter training. Specifically, it introduces an off-policy shift metric OPS, to quantify the off-policy deviation of partially generated trajectories. Guided by the OPS constraint, RollVerify performs both sequence-level and token-level verification to identify and truncate invalid suffixes of trajectories. This yields high-quality samples that protect the models' accuracy while preserving the efficiency gains of partial rollout. Experiments on mathematical and tool-assisted mathematical reasoning show that RollVerify achieves accuracy comparable to on-policy training while reducing training cost. Additional code-generation results provide preliminary evidence beyond mathematics.

</details>


### [380] [NeuralZip: Reusable Setup for Fast Lossless Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09916)
*Martín Bravo,Samuel Horváth,Gonzalo Navarro,Andrés Abeliuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeuralZip，通过对指数分布相似的分块共享Huffman码并选择性打包重复指数元组，实现可复用、可迁移的权重无损压缩，兼顾压缩率与速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型权重无损压缩虽能在不改变浮点数值的前提下降低存储与传输开销，但重复的统计分析与码本构造带来额外计算开销，需要研究指数统计结构能否"一次准备、多次复用"。

Method: NeuralZip将指数分布相似的数据块分组，共享Huffman码，并对重复出现的指数元组用packed exponents进行选择性表示；setup阶段预先选定表示方式，后续每次编码仍处理当前张量值；setup还可从兼容架构预计算并迁移。

Result: 浮点模型检查点上，setup后压缩比基线快1.81–21.33×，并实现逐比特精确重建；从兼容架构迁移setup可保持相近压缩率并免去setup摊销；训练检查点随权重演化持续复用；GPU实验在精确复现logits的同时减少活跃显存最高达27.5%。

Conclusion: 压缩适配是可迁移、可复用的：指数统计结构可一次准备、跨架构迁移并在训练演化中持续使用，在获得额外无损压缩收益的同时显著降低开销与显存占用。

Abstract: Lossless compression can reduce the storage and movement of model weights without changing their floating-point values, but repeated statistical analysis and code construction add computational overhead. We study whether the statistical structure of exponents can be prepared once and reused. For this, we introduce NeuralZip, which groups chunks with similar exponent distributions, shares Huffman codes, and selectively represents recurring exponent tuples using packed exponents, thereby achieving additional moderate compression ratios. A setup chooses these representations before subsequent encodings, while every encoding still processes the current tensor values. In floating-point model checkpoints, post-setup compression is 1.81-21.33$\times$ faster than the baselines and achieves exact bit-to-bit reconstruction. We show that this setup can be precomputed and transferred from another compatible architecture, preserving similar compression ratios and avoiding the need to amortize setup costs. Therefore, compression adaptation is transferable and reusable. Training checkpoints demonstrate continued reuse as the weights evolve. Finally, GPU experiments reduce active memory usage by up to 27.5$\%$ while reproducing the logits exactly.

</details>


### [381] [Eigenvalues of the Hessian in Deep Learning: The Origin of Symmetry and Its Breaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09919)
*Yossi Arjevani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出用"高度对称参考构型"视角解释深度网络训练后Hessian谱的普遍结构：近零大簇与少量孤立离群值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练后深度模型的Hessian谱呈现稳定经验规律——特征值分为近零的大bulk和少数孤立outlier，但缺乏统一理论解释其来源。

Method: 将原模型视为对某个隐藏的、高度对称的参考构型的偏离；通过修改架构、数据分布或参数度量揭示该参考构型，其Hessian具有超越权重对称性的丰富不变性，从而迫使出现高维核与大重数特征值；回到原构型则对称性破缺，产生簇与离群值的层级结构。框架具有一般性，详细分析三层ReLU网络，并推广到卷积、图、Transformer模型及NTK。

Result: 该机制统一解释了Hessian谱中的大bulk与离群值，并在层间Hessian与Gauss-Newton矩阵中给出类似谱结构。

Conclusion: Hessian谱现象可归因于对近邻高对称参考构型的偏离与对称性破缺，为理解深度学习损失landscape的谱结构提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Hessian spectra at trained models in deep learning exhibit a persistent pattern: eigenvalues organize into distinct clusters, including a large bulk near zero and a few isolated outliers. This paper shows that a natural account of these spectral phenomena emerges when the original setting is understood as a departure from a nearby, otherwise hidden, highly symmetric reference.
  Modifications, including changes to the architecture, data distribution, or parameter metric, expose a nearby reference configuration whose Hessian exhibits rich invariances-ones not accounted for by weight symmetries. There, symmetry enables a precise description of the spectra, forcing high-dimensional kernels and eigenvalues of large multiplicity. Returning to the original configuration breaks the Hessian symmetry and thereby produces the observed hierarchy of clusters and outliers.
  The framework is developed in some generality, with a detailed analysis of three-layer ReLU networks and applications to convolutional, graph, and transformer models, as well as to the NTK. The same mechanism is further shown to yield analogous spectral structures in layerwise Hessians and the Gauss-Newton matrix.

</details>


### [382] [KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09927)
*Benjamin Loire,Galadriel Brière,Célia Brahimi,Antoine Toffano,Anaïs Baudot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KGATE：基于PyTorch Geometric与TorchKGE的模块化知识图谱自编码器训练库，支持组件装配与自定义模块，具有防数据泄漏预处理、内置训练流程与可复现性设计；基准测试显示其训练时间与最快库相当，同时功能覆盖更广。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识图谱嵌入（KGE）库大多仅支持编码器或解码器，难以构建完整的自编码器；且常缺乏维护、依赖未文档化的默认超参数，导致不同库之间结果无法比较。因此需要一个完整、模块化且可复现的KGE自编码器训练环境。

Method: KGATE为模块化Python库，构建于PyTorch Geometric与TorchKGE之上。用户可将初始化器、编码器、解码器、损失函数、负采样器和评估指标作为构建模块进行组合，也可插入自定义模块。库中包含控制数据泄漏的预处理流程、内置训练管线，并以可复现性为设计原则。

Result: 与六个现有KGE库的基准测试表明，KGATE的训练时间与最快库相当，同时提供更广泛的功能集。

Conclusion: KGATE填补了完整KGE自编码器工具链的空白，在保持高训练效率的同时提升了模块化程度、功能覆盖与结果可复现性。

Abstract: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.

</details>


### [383] [Expected Sample Complexity in Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09929)
*Nadav Sukenik,Nadav Merlis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机多臂老虎机问题中的样本复杂度，提出"期望近似正确（ACE）"框架，分析确定性算法不可行性及两种ε已知/未知设定下的随机算法，并给出近乎紧致的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 样本复杂度（次优决策次数）是序贯决策中的常用指标，但现有度量下的保证与收敛性质存在局限（如高概率保证），需要新的分析框架来刻画期望意义下的样本复杂度及其与最优期望回报收敛的关系。

Method: 引入"期望近似正确（ACE）"框架来分析样本复杂度；证明ACE保证蕴含几乎必然收敛到最优期望回报，并给出将ACE保证转化为显式期望遗憾界的方法；分析确定性算法在该框架下无法获得有利界；在ε已知时设计explore-then-ε-greedy算法，在ε未知时分析Thompson采样的期望样本复杂度；对两种设定建立近乎匹配的下界。

Result: ACE保证蕴含几乎必然收敛到最优期望回报（区别于其他框架的高概率保证），并可转化为显式期望遗憾界；确定性算法无法获得有利的ACE界；explore-then-ε-greedy与Thompson采样在两种设定下分别达到近乎紧致的性能；下界证明算法在ε上是紧的，并揭示了ε已知与未知两种机制之间的性能分离。

Conclusion: ACE框架为随机多臂老虎机的期望样本复杂度提供了新的理论分析工具，明确了随机算法（而非确定性算法）的必要性，并刻画了ε已知/未知两种情形间的性能分离，下界与算法上界近乎匹配。

Abstract: Sample complexity is a widely used metric in sequential decision-making problems, defined as the number of suboptimal decisions during the interaction between the agent and an environment. We study the sample complexity of stochastic multi-armed bandit problems and introduce the expected sample complexity performance measure, analyzing it in a novel framework called approximately correct in expectation (ACE). We show that ACE guarantees imply almost sure convergence to the optimal expected reward, in contrast to high-probability guarantees found in other frameworks, and also show how to convert ACE guarantees into explicit expected regret bounds. We further show that, in contrast to existing measures, deterministic algorithms cannot obtain favorable ACE bounds, and analyze stochastic algorithms in two settings: when the allowed suboptimality level $ε$ is known to the algorithm and when it is unknown. In the former, we devise an explore-then-$ε$-greedy algorithm, and in the latter, we analyze the expected sample complexity of Thompson sampling. Finally, we establish nearly matching lower bounds for both settings, showing that the algorithms are tight in $ε$ and proving a performance separation between the two regimes.

</details>


### [384] [Learning Traffic Flow Dynamics with Stochastic Physics-Informed Neural Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09946)
*Federica Bragone,Matthieu Barreau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出物理信息神经细胞自动机（PI-NCA），用于数据驱动的交通流建模，通过学习局部转移规则并保证车辆总数守恒，成功复现Nagel-Schreckenberg和Kerner-Klenov-Wolf模型的动力学，并优于标准NCA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通流建模对理解和预测路网中车辆的集体动力学至关重要。细胞自动机以局部交互规则提供简单、可解释且强大的框架，能再现复杂宏观交通现象。然而，从数据中学习局部转移规则并同时保持物理上有意义的约束仍然困难，尤其对随机模型而言。

Method: 在标准神经细胞自动机（NCA）基础上，设计一种与道路拓扑物理一致、并保证车辆总数守恒的神经架构，从而将学习到的转移规则约束为物理上可接受的动力学。进一步将框架扩展到随机动力学，通过参数化概率转移规则，同时保持相同的物理约束。

Result: 在由Nagel-Schreckenberg和Kerner-Klenov-Wolf细胞自动机生成的多种交通场景上进行评估。结果表明，PI-NCA成功学习了两类交通模型的动力学，并持续优于标准NCA；随机扩展能够捕捉概率转移规则，同时不破坏所施加的物理约束。

Conclusion: PI-NCA为数据驱动的交通流建模提供了一种兼顾物理一致性与守恒约束的学习框架，适用于确定性与随机动力学，并在与标准NCA的对比中表现更优。

Abstract: Traffic flow modeling is essential for understanding and predicting the collective dynamics of vehicles on road networks. Cellular automata provide a simple, interpretable yet powerful framework for representing these dynamics via local interaction rules, while retaining the ability to reproduce complex macroscopic traffic phenomena. However, learning local transition rules from data while preserving physically meaningful constraints remains challenging, particularly for stochastic models. In this work, we propose a physics-informed neural cellular automaton (PI-NCA) for data-driven traffic flow modeling. Building on the standard neural cellular automaton (NCA), we design a neural architecture that is physically consistent with the road topology and guarantees conservation of the total number of vehicles, thereby constraining the learned transition rules to physically admissible dynamics. We further extend this framework to stochastic dynamics by parameterizing probabilistic transition rules while preserving the same physics-informed constraints. We evaluate the proposed models on multiple traffic scenarios generated by the well-established Nagel-Schreckenberg and Kerner-Klenov-Wolf cellular automata. The results demonstrate that the PI-NCA successfully learns the dynamics of both traffic models and consistently outperforms a standard NCA, while the stochastic extension captures probabilistic transition rules without compromising the imposed physical constraints.

</details>


### [385] [Force without transmission: a depth-induced rank collapse that no loss on the representation reopens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09958)
*Martin Hofmann,Patrick Mäder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文探究秩坍塌（rank collapse）是否可通过类似修复注意力坍塌的有界修正损失项来修复，发现关键在于梯度路径是否通畅而非修正力的大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知训练会使Transformer发生秩坍塌（所有token表示指向同一方向，学习停滞），且在注意力坍塌中，带界修正力的损失项可在训练中修复网络。作者由此提问：这种损失项是否也能修复秩坍塌，并想弄清修复失败的真正原因。

Method: 通过削弱跳跃连接使小型Transformer发生秩坍塌，并以坍塌网络的多个副本作为被试；加入不同强度的损失修正项，追踪任务梯度与附加项梯度在queries/keys权重及形成坍塌的block处的传播路径；进一步通过恢复跳跃连接（不改变任何权重）来检验路径效应。

Result: 任何附加损失项都未能修复坍塌，即使较强项推力约为任务梯度的十分之一；原因是路径而非强度——任务梯度不再到达决定注意力指向的query和key权重，附加项的梯度在坍塌形成的block之前就已衰减。恢复跳跃连接立即重开该路径（无需改变权重），秩随即恢复，但仅在远高于坍塌尺度的范围；经历一次高学习率爆发后路径保持开放，秩在无干预下恢复。基于路径的注册预测能对恢复时间排序，但无法迁移到该成因上；所有情况下秩恢复后损失仍高于健康网络。

Conclusion: 坍塌网络能否被修复取决于梯度是否仍能到达必须改变的权重，而不取决于损失项推力的大小；恢复梯度路径（而非增大修正力）才是修复关键。

Abstract: Training can drive a transformer into a rank collapse: all token representations point in one direction, and learning stops. In a related collapse of attention, a loss term with a bounded corrective force repairs the network during the run. We ask whether such a term repairs rank collapse. We collapse small transformers by weakening their skip connection and treat copies of the collapsed network. No added loss term repaired the collapse, although the stronger kind pushed with about a tenth of the task gradient. The reason was the path, not the strength. The task gradient no longer reached the query and key weights, which decide where attention looks, and the added term's gradient faded before the blocks where the collapse forms. Restoring the skip connection, which changes no weight, reopened this path at once. The rank then recovered, but only far above the scale of collapse. After a burst of high learning rate the path stayed open and the rank recovered untreated. Registered predictions from the path ranked recovery times but did not transfer to this cause. In every case the loss stayed above that of a healthy network after the rank recovered. Whether a collapsed network can be repaired depends on whether the gradient still reaches the weights that must change, not on how strongly a loss term pushes.

</details>


### [386] [TR-PTQ: High-Accuracy Integer-Only Transformer Post Training Quantization via Taylor Region Reformulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09969)
*Eliyahu Levy,Adam Teman,Yoni Pugachov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TR-PTQ 提出统一的纯整数后训练量化方案，通过共享 Taylor Region 指数/对数原语将除法与开方转入对数域，并针对 LayerNorm 参数做免校准、异常值感知优化，消除非线性层的浮点回退，在视觉与语言基准上绝对精度损失小于 1.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法认为 Transformer 量化精度损失源于数值精度不足，因而常需浮点回退，但本文指出真正的退化来自特定结构性误差源：归一化层中可学习的缩放参数与 GELU 的复合近似是主要误差来源，而 SoftMax 对激进量化本身具有鲁棒性。

Method: 提出 TR-PTQ：1) 统一纯整数公式，使用共享的 Taylor Region（TR）指数与对数原语；2) 借助该原语将对数域中代价高昂的除法与平方根运算全部用标准整数算术完成；3) 对 LayerNorm 参数采用免校准、异常值感知的优化。

Result: 在视觉与语言基准上实现小于 1.5% 的绝对精度下降，且非线性运算无需浮点硬件单元。

Conclusion: Transformer 非线性层的量化退化主要由归一化缩放参数与 GELU 近似误差引起，而非数值精度不足；TR-PTQ 通过共享 TR 指数/对数原语与免校准 LayerNorm 优化，实现了无浮点回退的纯整数推理并保持高精度。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment, yet transformer architectures remain challenging to quantize due to nonlinear layers. While existing methods attribute accuracy loss to insufficient numerical precision, often necessitating floating-point fallbacks, we demonstrate that degradation is actually driven by specific structural error sources. We find that learned scale parameters in normalization layers and compounded approximations in GELU are the primary error contributors, whereas SoftMax remains inherently robust to aggressive quantization. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce TR-PTQ, a unified integer-only formulation using shared Taylor Region (TR) exponential and logarithm primitives. This approach allows computationally expensive operations, including division and square roots, to be performed entirely in the log-domain via standard integer arithmetic. Combined with a calibration-free, outlier-aware optimization for LayerNorm parameters, our method eliminates the need for floating-point hardware units for nonlinearities, achieving less than 1.5\% absolute accuracy degradation across vision and language benchmarks.

</details>


### [387] [Efficient Patch-Based Anomaly Detection Fused with Diffusion Driven Generative Modeling for Semiconductor Wafer Bin Map Open Set Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09993)
*Limon Bin Hossain,Md Sadib Rahman Ananta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EfficientAD 与 DDPM 部分扩散重建耦合的混合单类检测框架，采用百分位校准的固定凸组合融合打分；在 WM-38K 混合型数据集（700 正常训练，18,658 测试）上 AUROC 达 0.9985，误分类降至 618。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 晶圆图（WBM）空间缺陷特征可追溯良率损失至特定工艺故障，但监督分类器只能识别训练中见过的缺陷类型；而基于单一机制的单类检测器往往要么捕捉局部结构偏差，要么捕捉全局分布违背，难以兼得。

Method: 混合单类框架：patch-based student-teacher 检测器（EfficientAD）与去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的部分扩散重建相结合，对两模块分数做百分位校准后以固定凸组合融合。仅在 WM-38K 混合型数据集的 700 片正常晶圆上训练。

Result: 在 18,658 片留出晶圆上，融合检测器 AUROC 0.9985，误分类由 DDPM 的 852、EfficientAD 的 1,412 降至 618，所有两两差异 p<0.001。增益源于两模块错误的弱重叠，但固定权重融合仅实现 oracle 选择器可获得矫正量的 40-70%。在基准的类别平衡倒置下，平均精度与 F1 饱和，而 MCC 与 NPV 揭示正常预测不可靠；像素级图显示图像级可分性强并不意味着空间定位能力，扩散模块作为局部密度先验而非全局几何推理起作用。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持面向样本自适应融合与考虑类别不平衡的混合晶圆异常检测评估方法。

Abstract: Spatial defect signatures on wafer bin maps (WBMs) trace yield loss to specific process faults, yet supervised classifiers recognize only the defect types seen during training, and one-class detectors built on a single mechanism tend to capture either local structural deviations or global distributional violations, but rarely both. This work proposes a hybrid one-class framework that couples a patch-based student-teacher detector (EfficientAD) with a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) used for partial-diffusion reconstruction, and fuses their percentile-calibrated scores through a fixed convex combination. Trained on only 700 normal wafers from the WM-38K mixed-type dataset and evaluated on 18,658 held-out wafers, the fused detector reached an AUROC of 0.9985 and reduced misclassifications from 852 (DDPM) and 1,412 (EfficientAD) to 618, with all pairwise differences significant at p < 0.001. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the analysis shows that the gain arises from weakly overlapping errors between the two modules, yet fixed-weight fusion recovers only 40-70% of the correction available to an oracle selector. Under the benchmark's inverted class balance, average precision and F1 saturate, while the Matthews correlation coefficient and negative predictive value expose unreliable normal predictions. Pixel-level maps further show that strong image-level separability does not imply spatial localization, and the diffusion module succeeds as a local density prior rather than through global geometric reasoning. These findings motivate sample-adaptive fusion and imbalance-aware evaluation of hybrid wafer anomaly detectors.

</details>


### [388] [Temporal Predictive Multiplicity: Equally Accurate Time Series Models Yield Different Forecast Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09994)
*Emanuele Albini,Francesca Toni,Saumitra Mishra,Francesco Leofante*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"时间预测多重性"框架，刻画性能近乎相同的模型在完整预测轨迹层面的分歧，并证明仅约束预测性能或逐时域多重性都无法消除轨迹级分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具有近乎相同预测性能的模型可能产生差异显著的预测（预测多重性）。既有研究多针对单个标量输出，而时间序列预测中各时域预测共同构成一条轨迹，逐时域比较会掩盖预测行为的重要差异，因此需要从轨迹层面重新刻画多重性。

Method: 提出"时间预测多重性"（temporal predictive multiplicity）框架，用于刻画性能近乎相同的模型在完整预测轨迹上的分歧；分析仅约束预测性能时所容许的轨迹范围，并考察在单个时域上约束多重性对轨迹级多重性的削减作用；在11个数据集、19种神经预测架构上开展实验。

Result: 仅约束预测性能仍可容纳范围广泛的轨迹；在单个时域上约束多重性只能部分降低而不能消除轨迹级多重性。实验表明，近乎最优的模型在预测轨迹上存在显著变异，且轨迹级分歧与逐时域分歧基本无关。

Conclusion: 现有预测多重性研究存在空白：预测性能无法区分的模型可能对应根本不同的时间轨迹，并对下游任务产生实质性影响；需在轨迹层面评估与管理多重性。

Abstract: Models with near-identical predictive performance can yield substantially different predictions, a phenomenon known as predictive multiplicity. Prior work has mostly studied this at the level of individual scalar outputs. In time-series forecasting, however, predictions across horizons jointly define a trajectory, and horizon-wise comparisons can hide important differences in predictive behavior. To address this problem, we introduce temporal predictive multiplicity, a framework that characterizes disagreement over complete forecast trajectories among models with near-identical predictive performance. We show that constraining predictive performance alone can still admit a broad range of different trajectories. We further show that constraining multiplicity at individual horizons partially reduces, but does not eliminate, trajectory-level multiplicity. Experiments with 19 neural forecasting architectures on 11 datasets confirm that near-optimal models can exhibit substantial variability in the forecast trajectories they produce, and trajectory-level disagreement is largely unrelated to horizon-wise disagreement. Our framework, therefore, exposes a gap in existing multiplicity studies: models with indistinguishable predictive performance imply fundamentally different temporal trajectories, with consequential downstream effects.

</details>


### [389] [Beyond Reward Suppression: Near-Optimal Offline Attacks on Warm-Start Bandits with Bounded Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10000)
*Qirun Zeng,Manhin Poon,Xiangxiang Dai,Qixin Zhang,Jinhang Zuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"预热启动"赌博机中的有界离线攻击，证明在特定条件下"目标提升"是理论必需而非启发式策略，并提出达到最优次线性代价的攻击方法，同时推广至TS、ε-greedy等算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对赌博机的对抗攻击多通过"压制非目标臂"来误导学习器选择目标臂；但现实中诸如虚假评论等操纵手段往往直接"提升目标物品"。作者希望通过研究预热启动赌博机下的有界离线攻击，弥补这一理论与实践之间的差距，并厘清目标提升与压制非目标臂之间的代价分配机制。

Method: 攻击者仅能在部署前向预热历史中注入合法的"动作-奖励"对（有界离线攻击）。作者对该问题进行了理论分析：针对UCB算法，证明当目标臂接近奖励下界时，任何使其在几乎所有在线轮次被选中的阶最优代价攻击，必须将不可忽略比例的攻击代价分配给目标臂本身。在此基础上，作者设计了一种攻击方法，达成最优次线性代价，并刻画其在"目标提升"与"非目标压制"之间的代价分配。随后将该攻击推广至Thompson Sampling、ε-greedy 及更广泛的赌博机算法类。

Result: 理论结果证明目标提升在特定条件下是阶最优攻击的必要组成部分，并给出了达到最优次线性代价的攻击及其代价分配刻画。在真实与合成数据集上的实验验证了所提攻击的有效性。

Conclusion: 目标提升并非单纯的启发式技巧，而是在某些情形下的理论必然；本文提出的攻击在UCB及多种主流赌博机算法上均能达到最优次线性代价，拓展了对抗攻击的作用范围与理解。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks on bandits aim to mislead a learner toward a target arm while keeping the attack cost small. Existing attacks typically achieve this by suppressing non-target arms. In practice, however, manipulation such as fake reviews often directly promotes the target item. We study this gap through bounded offline attacks on warm-start bandits, where an attacker can inject only valid action-reward pairs into the warm-start history before deployment. We show that target promotion is not merely a heuristic: when the target arm lies near the lower reward boundary, any order-optimal-cost attack against UCB that makes it selected in nearly all online rounds must allocate a nonvanishing fraction of its cost to the target arm. We then design an attack that achieves the optimal sublinear cost and characterize its allocation between target promotion and non-target suppression. We further extend the attack to Thompson Sampling, $ε$-greedy, and a broader class of bandit algorithms. Experiments on real-world and synthetic data validate the effectiveness of our attacks.

</details>


### [390] [A Drosophila Whole-Connectome Network Can Learn Human-Designed Cognitive Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10014)
*Joonghui Cho,Minchan Kang,Daeshik Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将雄性果蝇全脑连接组（MaleCNS v1.0）作为人工网络的固定循环拓扑，每条解剖学边学习一个标量权重，在受限加法任务和基于100词词表的具身关系语言任务上验证该生物接线图能否作为可复用的计算基底。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究生物接线图（连接组）是否能超越其进化所服务的行为，作为通用计算基底，为人工网络提供可迁移的归纳偏置。

Method: 以公开的成年雄性果蝇MaleCNS v1.0连接组作为固定循环拓扑，无需学习结构；对每条解剖学边仅学习一个标量权重；分别训练受限加法模型与受控具身关系语言模型（固定100词词表）；采用保持有向度分布的随机重连网络作为对照，并在多个固定接口和21图比较中进行评估，同时通过打乱任务定义的感官特征进行干预分析。

Result: 在留出加法任务上，解剖图达到92.77%平均准确率，而保持有向度重连为67.93%；在严格配对的场景-描述匹配语言端点上，跨四个固定接口达到61.59%，重连为44.17%；在标准接口上于21个固定图比较中排名第一；在48组匹配干预子集上，打乱任务定义感官特征使得分从60.94%降至19.27%。

Conclusion: MaleCNS的高阶接线为受限加法和具身关系语言提供了可复用的归纳偏置，表明生物连接组可作为超出其进化功能之外的有效计算基底。

Abstract: Can a biological wiring diagram serve as a useful computational substrate beyond the behaviors for which it evolved? We use the publicly released MaleCNS v1.0 connectome, reconstructed from a single adult male Drosophila specimen, as the fixed recurrent topology of an artificial network. We train separate models for bounded addition and for a controlled grounded relational language task built from a fixed 100-word lexicon. In both models, one scalar is learned per anatomical edge. The anatomical graph reaches 92.77% mean accuracy on held-out addition, compared with 67.93% for directed degree-preserving rewires. On the strict paired language endpoint, which matches original and order-reversed scenes to their corresponding descriptions, it reaches 61.59% across four fixed interfaces, compared with 44.17% for matched rewires. At the canonical interface, it ranks first in a fixed 21-graph comparison. On the matched 48-group intervention subset, shuffling task-defined sensory features reduces its score from 60.94% to 19.27%. Together, these results show that higher-order MaleCNS wiring provides a reusable inductive bias for bounded addition and grounded relational language.

</details>


### [391] [Oscillatory Neural Dynamics over Sheaves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10018)
*Jan-Willem Van Looy,Alessandro Trenta,Alessio Gravina,Alessio Borgi,Ferdinando Zanchetta,Pietro Liò,Davide Bacciu,Rita Fioresi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ONDA，一个基于算子值信息波（operator-valued information waves）的长程图学习框架，将二阶波动力学与可学习的层束传输算子（sheaf transport operators）结合，使茎值（stalk-valued）表示在图上进行波式传播，从而提升长程信息通信效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络中长程传播是核心难题：单纯增大传播深度并不能保证远端节点之间有效相互影响。层束神经网络（sheaf neural networks）通过茎之间的矩阵值传输增强了表达能力，但仅靠这种表达能力并不能自动实现有效的长程通信。因此作者希望找到一种既能保留层束局部几何表达力、又能真正实现长程影响的传播机制。

Method: ODNA 采用算子值（operator-valued）信息波框架：茎值表示由可学习层束传输算子驱动的二阶动力学进行演化，将波式传播与具有表达力的局部几何相结合。作者通过逐茎敏感性分析（stalk-wise sensitivity analysis）刻画远程影响，并论证其交叉影响不会衰减到零。

Result: 在长程传播、严重图瓶颈（graph bottlenecks）、图迁移（graph transfer）以及异配（heterophilic）基准上，ONDA 相对标量波传播、扩散式层束基线以及当前最先进模型均取得一致提升，验证了将波动力学与矩阵值传输耦合带来的收益。

Conclusion: 将二阶波动力学与层束的矩阵值/算子值传输耦合，是实现有效长程图传播的有效途径，其交叉影响不消失的特性从理论敏感性分析上得到支持，并在多类长程与异配任务上获得经验验证。

Abstract: Effective long-range propagation remains a central challenge in graph neural networks, as increasing a model's propagation depth does not guarantee that distant nodes effectively influence each other. Sheaf neural networks enrich graph propagation through matrix-valued transport between stalks; still, this expressivity alone does not automatically imply effective long-range communication. We introduce ONDA, a long-range graph learning framework based on operator-valued information waves. Stalk-valued representations evolve through second-order dynamics governed by learned sheaf transport operators, combining wave-like propagation with expressive local geometry. We characterize long-range influence through a stalk-wise sensitivity analysis and show that the cross-influence never vanishes. Across long-range propagation, severe graph bottlenecks, graph transfer, and heterophilic benchmarks, ONDA consistently improves over scalar wave propagation, diffusive sheaf baselines, and state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the benefit of coupling wave dynamics with matrix-valued transport.

</details>


### [392] [Matching of signal, noise and hardware timescales for filtering and forecasting of correlated noise signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10037)
*Joshua Donald,Alex Gabbitas,Arthur G. T. Coveney,Sergey Savel'ev,Pavel Borisov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 纳米多孔氧化铌储备池实验表明，噪声相关时间与储备池记忆、预测时域之间的匹配关系决定相关噪声是被滤除还是被预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理储备池计算虽比传统机器学习更节能，但其内在响应时间尺度固定，而真实信号包含跨多个时间尺度的确定性与随机成分，因此需要厘清时间尺度匹配如何影响对随机分量的处理。

Method: 以纳米多孔氧化铌作为物理储备池，使用合成含噪信号与加密货币价格波动数据，分析噪声相关时间、储备池记忆与预测时域之间的关系；提出储备池记忆时域（reservoir memory horizon）与预测机制指数（forecasting regime index）来区分不同工作区制。

Result: 变化快于储备池记忆与预测时域的噪声被储备池平均化（滤除）；变化较慢的噪声其时间结构足以支持算法预测。

Conclusion: 时间尺度匹配可指导输入时间序列的编码方式，以及用于跨不同时间尺度滤除、分析和预测随机信号成分的物理储备池架构设计。

Abstract: Physical reservoir computing exploits the nonlinear dynamics of physical systems to process time-dependent data with greater energy efficiency than conventional machine learning approaches. However, physical reservoirs have fixed intrinsic response timescales, whereas real-world signals combine deterministic and stochastic components across multiple timescales. Here we show, using a nanoporous niobium oxide reservoir, synthetic noisy signals and cryptocurrency-price volatility, that the relationship among noise correlation time, reservoir memory and forecast horizon determines whether correlated noise is filtered or predicted. Noise varying faster than the relevant reservoir memory and forecast horizon is averaged by the reservoir, whereas the temporal structure of slower-varying noise is sufficient for algorithmic forecasting. We introduce the reservoir memory horizon and forecasting regime index to distinguish these operating regimes. These contributions demonstrate that timescale matching can guide the encoding of input time series and development of physical reservoir architectures that filter, analyse and predict stochastic signal components across distinct temporal scales.

</details>


### [393] [WxFM-XL: Adapting Univariate Foundation Models to Multi-Station Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10057)
*Xiao Wang,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Rongwen Li,Hongwu Liu,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 WxFM-XL，通过引入跨站点误差相关先验图与动态融合机制，将单变量时间序列基础模型适配到多站点天气预报任务，实验表明其优于现有最优基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多变量扩展工作主要建模变量间的相关性，但在多站点天气预报场景中忽略了两个关键因素：（1）站点的空间信息；（2）不同站点相对于基础模型的误差先验差异。

Method: WxFM-XL 首先构建跨站点误差相关先验图，以刻画各站点相对基础模型的误差先验；在此基础上提出动态融合机制，自适应地融合空间相关图与误差相关先验图。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该模型性能优于当前最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: 针对单变量时间序列基础模型向多站点天气预报的适配问题，显式建模站点空间信息与站点级误差先验，并通过动态图融合加以整合，是一种有效且性能领先的方案。

Abstract: With the rise of univariate time series foundation models (e.g., Sundial, Timer), initial efforts have been made to extend them to multivariate settings. However, these models mainly focus on modeling correlations among variables. When they are applied to multi-station weather forecasting, two important factors are often overlooked: (1) the spatial information of stations, and (2) different error priors of different stations relative to the foundation model. In this paper, we propose WxFM-XL, a model for adapting univariate time series foundation models to multi-station weather forecasting. WxFM-XL introduces a cross-station error correlation prior graph to capture stationwise error priors with respect to the foundation model. Building on this, we further propose a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively integrates a spatial correlation graph with the error correlation prior graph. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms state of the art baselines.

</details>


### [394] [Efficient Provably Private Classification with a Tabular Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10068)
*Talal Alrawajfeh,Cristiana Diaconu,Ossi Räisä,Sebastian Rodriguez Beltran,Yuan He,John Bronskill,Richard E. Turner,Antti Honkela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PrivTab是一种将隐私机制内嵌于架构的表格基础模型，通过模拟数据预训练与上下文学习，把敏感行转化为可证明私密的紧凑摘要，在中等至强隐私下超越私有线性与神经网络基线，泄漏可忽略、校准良好，且拟合时间缩短1万倍，仅需单次前向传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据广泛支撑医学、金融、政府与科学领域的预测与决策，但常含敏感个体信息，需在保证预测精度的同时保护隐私。传统私有学习虽有形式化隐私保证，却需针对数据集缓慢优化、强隐私下效用损失大且难以正确应用；现有表格基础模型虽能快速适配新数据集，却缺乏形式化隐私保证并极易受成员推断攻击，限制其在敏感数据上的使用。

Method: 提出PrivTab——一种易用的差分隐私分类表格基础模型，将隐私机制嵌入其架构。模型在模拟数据集上预训练，利用上下文学习将敏感行转换为紧凑且可证明私密的摘要，实质上学习"在隐私约束下如何学习"。

Result: 在中等至强隐私条件下，PrivTab优于私有线性与神经网络基线；成员泄漏可忽略；在强隐私下仍保持良好校准的预测；将数据集拟合时间缩短1万倍，仅需一次前向传播。

Conclusion: PrivTab结合了形式化隐私、速度与易用性，将近期AI进展带给那些因敏感个体级数据而受限的应用场景，推动隐私保护预测的实际落地。

Abstract: Tabular data underpin prediction and decision-making in medicine, finance, government and science, but often contain sensitive individual-level information, creating a need for accurate prediction while preserving privacy. Traditional private learning provides formal privacy guarantees, but requires slow dataset-specific optimisation, suffers substantial utility loss under strong privacy, and is often difficult to apply correctly. Tabular foundation models adapt rapidly to new datasets, but existing models lack formal privacy guarantees, and are highly vulnerable to membership-inference attacks, limiting their use on sensitive data. Here we introduce PrivTab, an easy to use tabular foundation model for differentially private classification that embeds a privacy mechanism within its architecture. Pretrained on simulated datasets, PrivTab uses in-context learning to transform sensitive rows into compact, provably private summaries---effectively learning how to learn under privacy. PrivTab outperforms private linear and neural-network baselines under moderate-to-strong privacy, shows negligible membership leakage, maintains well-calibrated predictions under strong privacy, and reduces dataset fitting time by 10,000 times, requiring only a single forward pass. By combining formal privacy, speed, and easy of use, PrivTab brings recent advances in AI to applications where sensitive individual-level data have limited their adoption.

</details>


### [395] [Activation-Aware Weight Tensorization: A Calibration-Time Preconditioner for Tensor-Network LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10085)
*Alessandro Beatini,Marco Maronese,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练的激活感知权重张量化方法AWT，在张量网络压缩前用激活导出对角缩放预处理权重矩阵，部署时仅需输入侧逐元素缩放，可在不修改分解求解器的前提下提升函数保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练后张量网络压缩（TT/TTN）以权重空间Frobenius误差最小化为目标，而非在层激活分布下的函数误差最小化，导致压缩模型与稠密基线存在性能差距。

Method: AWT是一种免训练校准包装器：用激活分布导出对角缩放矩阵，对每个权重矩阵进行预条件处理，再交由原有TT/TTN求解器分解；部署时仅在输入侧施加逐元素重缩放，求解器保持不变。作者进一步分析对角预条件本质上是稳健性与模块性的权衡，而非对角协方差假设。

Result: 在Llama 3.1 8B、Ministral 8B、Qwen2.5 7B上，2-6倍压缩下AWT稳定优于普通TT/TTN：单算子替换时缩小WikiText困惑度差距12-35%，Llama后缀多算子替换时缩小27-60%（含注意力组与全部七个矩阵设定）；下游HellaSwag与ARC-Challenge同样受益。分析显示稠密全协方差oracle在其加权目标上80/81胜出，但对角AWT在53/81情形下取得更优的留出函数保真度。

Conclusion: AWT可作为固定TT/TTN压缩流程中提升函数保真度的原则性、模块化预条件器，无需修改分解求解器即可获得一致的性能改善。

Abstract: Post-training tensor-network compression replaces Transformer linear layers with Tensor Train (TT) or Tree Tensor Network (TTN) operators, but standard decompositions minimize weight-space Frobenius error rather than functional error under the layer's activation distribution. We propose Activation-aware Weight Tensorization (AWT), a training-free calibration wrapper that preconditions each weight matrix with a diagonal activation-derived scale before an unchanged TT/TTN solver and deploys the result with only an input-side elementwise rescaling. Across Llama 3.1 8B, Ministral 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, AWT consistently improves vanilla TT/TTN tensorization at 2-6 times compression: under single-operator replacement, AWT closes 12-35% of the WikiText perplexity gap to the dense baseline across the three model families and 2-6 times compression settings; while under multi-operator Llama suffix replacement it closes 27-60% across attention-group and all-seven-matrix settings. The gains also transfer to downstream HellaSwag and ARC-Challenge evaluations. We further show that diagonal preconditioning is a robustness-modularity tradeoff rather than a diagonal-covariance assumption: a dense full-covariance oracle wins its own weighted objective in 80/81 cases, yet diagonal AWT gives better held-out functional fidelity in 53/81 cases. Together, these results position AWT as a principled, modular preconditioner for improving functional fidelity in fixed TT/TTN compression pipelines without modifying the decomposition solver.

</details>


### [396] [CAFE+FNO: Fourier Kernel Generation via Multiplicative Feature Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10105)
*Hyungjoon Juen,Minwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CAFE+FNO，将内容感知频率编码（CAFE+）引入FNO的傅里叶核生成过程，通过Fourier-Chebyshev特征的并行仿射分支与Hadamard积构建频率交互，在五个PDE基准上对比现有FNO变体并进行消融实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FNO通过在傅里叶空间参数化核来学习PDE解算子，但频率截断会限制高频变化的学习。AM-FNO、SirenFNO等从谱坐标生成所有网格模态的核，使坐标编码与生成器设计变得关键；近期隐式神经表示（INR）研究表明显式特征组合构建频率交互优于依赖后续MLP隐式形成交互。

Method: 提出CAFE+FNO，将Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+（CAFE+）嵌入傅里叶核生成。CAFE+用并行仿射分支与Hadamard积组合Fourier-Chebyshev特征，在两个特征族内部及之间形成交互；核MLP将每个归一化谱坐标的表示映射为复通道混合矩阵。每层生成器在所有存储模态间共享，使固定结构下可训练参数量与模态数无关。

Result: 在五个PDE基准上与现有FNO变体进行对比，并针对基配置、乘法组合与带宽可学习性开展消融研究。

Conclusion: CAFE+通过显式频率交互改进傅里叶核生成，并以共享生成器实现参数量与模态数解耦，代码与实验配置已开源。

Abstract: The Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs) through Fourier-space kernel parameterization, but frequency truncation can limit the learning of high-frequency variations. AM-FNO and SirenFNO generate kernels for all grid modes from spectral coordinates using shared networks, making coordinate encoding and generator design important. Recent work on implicit neural representations (INRs) has proposed constructing frequency interactions through explicit feature composition rather than relying on subsequent MLPs to form them implicitly. Building on this approach, we propose CAFE+FNO, which incorporates Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) into Fourier kernel generation. CAFE+ combines Fourier--Chebyshev features through parallel affine branches and a Hadamard product, forming interactions within and across the two feature families. A kernel MLP maps the resulting representation of each normalized spectral coordinate to a complex channel-mixing matrix. Each layer shares its generator across all stored modes, making the number of trainable parameters independent of the number of modes for a fixed architecture. We compare CAFE+FNO with existing FNO variants on five PDE benchmarks and conduct ablation studies on basis configuration, multiplicative composition, and bandwidth learnability. Code and experimental configurations are available at https://github.com/fabsk101/CAFEPlusFNO.git.

</details>


### [397] [YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10118)
*Huishan Ji,Hua Xu,Weiming Zhang,Qirui Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: YANchor-4B是一种通用循环模型，通过将关键记忆保存为锚点（ANchors）供后续推理检索，在O(N)时间生成与O(1)内存下实现长程推理，性能显著超越线性时间、常量状态的同类模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程推理需要持续访问早期信息且生成成本可控。全历史注意力导致存储与计算随序列增长，而循环压缩可能丢失精确细节，因此需要兼顾效率与信息保真的方案。

Method: 提出YANchor-4B通用循环模型，将关键记忆保留为锚点（ANchors）供后续推理检索，并采用多维记忆机制，实现O(N)时间生成与O(1)内存。

Result: 在AIME 2024–2026上达到82.93%平均pass@1，HMMT上达63.64%，显著优于线性时间、常量状态的同类模型（含更大模型）；在H100上批量长生成吞吐量比Transformer和混合基线高出数倍；在数十个基准上展现通用能力优势。

Conclusion: YANchor通过锚点式多维记忆机制，在保持高效生成与常量内存的同时实现有效长程推理，并在数学推理、吞吐效率和通用能力上均具显著优势。

Abstract: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.

</details>


### [398] [What Can a Gaussian Process Design Test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10122)
*Ivan De Boi,Marnix Van Soom*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出对高斯过程模型检验的"前瞻性"解读：在设计阶段即可判断所选输入能产生何种矛盾，并据此预测检验功效、指导序贯设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯过程能与数据吻合，可能因假设正确，也可能因所选输入根本无法证伪假设；作者希望在观测响应之前就能区分这两种情形。

Method: 利用模型在给定输入下对无噪声响应所施加的代数关系（有限特征GP中恰为核矩阵的零空间），借助Gale对偶给出几何解释：每个观测对应一个向量，能暴露误差的最小观测组为circuit。对一般核，关系变为"软"约束，检验结合结构证据（违反关系，噪声趋零时无界增长）与先验证据（偏离在先验下概率低）。以预测功效作为序贯选点准则。

Result: 仿真中预测功效与实测拒绝率吻合；按预测功效选点将针对局部偏差的功效从0.48提升到0.72，而按预测方差选点仅为0.51；二维网格含精确的可加性检验，而拉丁超立方缺失。

Conclusion: 检验方法本身是经典的，贡献在于对其的前瞻性解读：在观测响应之前，设计已决定它能产生何种矛盾，因此可用于功效预测与主动设计。

Abstract: A Gaussian process (GP) model can agree with the data for two reasons: its assumptions are right, or the chosen inputs could never have shown that they are wrong. The distinction can be checked from the design before any responses are observed. Every model implies relations that its noiseless responses must satisfy at the chosen inputs, such as the middle value lies on the line through its two neighbours. For GPs built from finitely many features, these relations are exactly the null space of the kernel matrix. Gale duality gives them a geometric interpretation, in which each observation has a vector and the smallest groups of observations that can expose an error are the circuits. For other kernels the relations become soft: response patterns may be improbable under the prior rather than algebraically impossible. A standard test then combines two kinds of evidence. Structural evidence comes from a violated relation and grows without limit as the noise falls. Prior-based evidence only says that a departure is improbable under the prior. With all inputs at the two ends of an interval, for example, a GP can reject a straight line against a large curvature, but only because the implied intercept is improbable, never because curvature was seen. In simulations the predicted power matched the observed rejection rates. Choosing the next input by predicted power raised the power against a localised discrepancy from 0.48 to 0.72, against 0.51 when choosing by predictive variance, and a grid in two dimensions contained exact tests of additivity that a Latin hypercube lacked. The test itself is classical. The contribution is the prospective reading of that test: before observing the responses, the design already determines what kind of contradiction it can produce.

</details>


### [399] [m-Set Adversarial Bandits with Winner Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10128)
*Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi,Matteo Papini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究m-集对抗式老虎机在不同效用（赢家奖励或奖励和）与反馈模型（赢家索引、赢家奖励、奖励和及其组合）下的遗憾上下界，主要技术贡献为信息论下界，并用合成数据实验佐证理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合老虎机与MNL老虎机已有标准界，但m-集对抗式设定中效用定义与反馈模型的细微变化会导致学习速率剧烈变化，需要系统刻画这些差异并给出对应的遗憾界。该文旨在揭示设定微小改动对学习率的影响。

Method: 通过信息论方法推导不同设定组合下的遗憾下界，并结合已有上界技术给出相应的上界；随后在合成数据上进行实验验证。研究维度包括效用类型（赢家奖励、奖励和）与反馈模型（赢家索引、赢家奖励、奖励和及其组合）。

Result: 给出了m-集对抗式老虎机在上述多种效用与反馈组合下的遗憾上界与下界；通过与组合老虎机及MNL老虎机的标准界对比，显示设定变化对学习速率的显著影响；合成数据实验与理论分析一致。

Conclusion: m-集对抗式老虎机的学习速率对效用与反馈模型的细节高度敏感；信息论下界揭示了该问题的固有难度，为后续算法设计提供理论指导。

Abstract: We show upper and lower bounds on the regret of $m$-set adversarial bandits for different utilities (winner reward or sum of rewards) and feedback models (winner index, winner reward, sum of rewards, and their combinations). By comparing to standard bounds for combinatorial and MNL bandits, our results reveal how subtle changes in the setting can have a dramatic impact on the learning rates. Our main technical contributions are the information-theoretic lower bounds on the regret. Experiments on synthetic data confirm our theoretical analyses.

</details>


### [400] [A Unified Information-Theoretic Approach to Constrained Multi-Fidelity Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10174)
*Rikuto Matsumoto,Masanori Ishikura,Masayuki Karasuyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对多目标、约束与多保真度联合的贝叶斯优化问题，从信息论视角以"对最高保真可行Pareto前沿的信息增益"作为查询效用，通过变分下界近似该互信息，实现无需独立启发式的成本感知采集函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实优化问题常同时具有多目标、约束和不同保真度（评估成本）三重复杂性，而现有方法通常分别处理保真度选择与约束，缺乏统一框架来"联合"决定在何处以何种保真度进行下一次评估，以高效识别最高保真度下的可行Pareto前沿。

Method: 采用统一的信息论视角，将查询效用定义为某次观测关于目标Pareto前沿（最高保真可行前沿）的互信息。由于该互信息不可解析计算，作者构造变分下界：对"Pareto一致区域"分别使用欠截断（under-truncated）与过截断（over-truncated）近似构成的混合来界定该区域。多保真代理模型将信息传播至任意保真度，从而得到代价感知（cost-aware）的采集函数，其中保真度选择与约束处理均内嵌于同一信息增益准则，无需单独的启发式规则。

Result: 在合成问题、标准基准以及真实世界问题上进行了实验，结果表明该方法在不同目标数、约束条件与保真度设置的多样场景下均有效。

Conclusion: 通过以"对最高保真可行Pareto前沿的信息增益"为统一准则并结合变分下界与多保真代理模型，可在多目标、约束、多保真度联合设定下实现成本感知的联合查询决策，避免引入独立的保真度选择与约束处理启发式。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization often involves multiple objectives, constraints, and fidelity levels. We address the challenge of jointly selecting where and at which fidelity to evaluate to identify the highest-fidelity feasible Pareto frontier in this combined setting. From a unified information-theoretic perspective, we measure query utility by the information gain about this frontier, provided by an observation. Since this mutual information is intractable, we derive a variational lower bound using a mixture of under- and over-truncated approximations to the Pareto-consistent region. Multi-fidelity surrogate models propagate the information to arbitrary fidelities, yielding a cost-aware acquisition function without separate heuristics for fidelity selection or constraint handling. Experiments on synthetic, benchmark, and real-world problems demonstrate effectiveness across diverse objective, constraint, and fidelity settings.

</details>


### [401] [Pre-training of Bayesian Optimization Algorithm through Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10186)
*Satoshi Katayama,Shoyo Hunt,Shintaro Masuda,Masayuki Karasuyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于高斯过程样本路径的框架，用外层贝叶斯优化自动选择贝叶斯优化算法的超参数，以最小化期望累积遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化（BO）算法通常包含必须预先指定的参数，且性能对这些参数选择高度敏感。已有做法缺乏在BO启动阶段利用现有信息自动确定参数配置的原则性方法。

Method: 以BO起始时可获得的信息推断高斯过程（GP），并从该GP中采样生成样本路径；将候选参数配置对应的BO算法分别运行在这些样本路径上，得到期望累积遗憾的经验估计；由于该参数优化本身是黑箱优化问题，故再用一个BO过程（称为外层BO）来求解该估计的最小化问题。

Result: 实验表明，该框架能在候选参数配置集合中有效选出性能表现优异的参数配置。

Conclusion: 利用GP样本路径估计期望累积遗憾并以嵌套BO求解，是一种可行且有效的BO参数自动选择方案。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used as a standard approach for expensive black-box optimization. However, BO algorithms often involve parameters that must be specified in advance, and their performance can strongly depend on these choices. We propose a framework for optimizing such parameters using sample paths drawn from a Gaussian process (GP) inferred from the information available at the start of BO. We use cumulative regret as the performance metric for a BO algorithm. By running the BO algorithm on the generated sample paths, we obtain an empirical estimate of its expected cumulative regret for a given parameter configuration. Optimizing this estimate allows us to identify parameter configurations that, given the currently available information, are expected to achieve low cumulative regret. Since this parameter optimization is itself a black-box optimization problem, we employ another BO procedure to solve it, which we refer to as outer BO. Through experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively select parameter configurations that achieve strong performance among a range of candidate configurations.

</details>


### [402] [Robust Decentralized Fairness Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10199)
*Sayan Biswas,Jade Garcia Bourrée,Anne-Marie Kermarrec,Palak,Martijn de Vos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Auditopus，一种无需中心服务器的去中心化公平性审计方法，通过多审计员分轮提交累积统计向量并本地降权不一致审计员，抵御单一恶意审计员的“fairwashing”攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴立法要求对 LLM 进行公平性合规审计，但单一审计员难以获得覆盖相关人口群体的代表性查询集；多个审计员可协作覆盖，然而各审计员可能受 LLM 提供方指使伪造结果，制造公平假象（fairwashing），因此需要一种能在多方协作且存在对抗者的情况下保持稳健的公平性审计方案。

Method: Auditopus 采用无中心服务器的多轮审计：每轮每位审计员向 LLM 发出固定数量的查询，仅向其他审计员发送查询结果的累积统计向量而非敏感明文查询，再通过聚合所有向量估计被审计 LLM 的公平性。针对单个对抗审计员可通过伪造发送向量操纵估计的问题，Auditopus 让每个诚实审计员在本地对累积统计向量与既往向量在统计上不一致的审计员进行降权。

Result: 在两组数据集与两个预训练 LLM 上，与稳健聚合基线对比，面对以让 LLM 显得公平为目标的优化攻击，Auditopus 较无防御平均将审计误差降低最多 78%，较稳健聚合基线至少降低 62%；即使 49% 的审计员为对抗者，Auditopus 也从未让非常不公平或中等不公平的 LLM 被判定为公平。

Conclusion: Auditopus 表明去中心化、多审计员协作的公平性审计可在无需中心服务器、不暴露敏感查询的前提下实现对伪造统计向量攻击的稳健性，显著优于无防御与现有稳健聚合方法，并能在高比例对抗审计员下仍保持审计有效性。

Abstract: Emerging legislation requires large language models (LLMs) to be audited for compliance with regulatory standards, particularly fairness. Such black-box audits typically assume a single auditor with access to a large, representative set of queries. In practice, it can be difficult for an auditor to obtain such a query set, but multiple auditors can together cover the relevant demographic groups by auditing the LLM collaboratively with their individual query sets. However, relying on multiple auditors raises a fundamental trust problem, as they may act on behalf of the LLM provider to portray a misleading appearance of fairness, i.e., fairwashing. We propose Auditopus, a novel approach for robust decentralized fairness auditing. In Auditopus, auditing proceeds in rounds without a central server. In each round, every auditor issues a fixed number of queries to the LLM, and sends only cumulative statistics vectors of its query results to other auditors instead of sensitive queries in clear. The fairness of the audited LLM is then estimated by aggregating all the vectors. We show theoretically and empirically that even a single adversarial auditor in the network can steer this estimate by fabricating the vectors it sends, making an unfair LLM appear fair. To address this threat, Auditopus has each honest auditor locally down-weight any auditor whose cumulative statistics vectors are statistically inconsistent with previous ones. We implement Auditopus and compare it to robust aggregation baselines on two datasets with two pre-trained LLMs. Against an attacker that optimizes the vectors it sends to make the LLM appear fair, Auditopus reduces audit error by up to 78% on average relative to no defense and at least 62% relative to the robust aggregation baselines. Even when 49% of the auditors are adversarial, Auditopus never lets a very unfair or moderately unfair LLM pass as fair.

</details>


### [403] [How to train your model organism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10203)
*Xilin Wang,David Bau,Byron C. Wallace*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文主张模型生物体（model organisms）的训练不应仅以安装目标行为为单一目标，而应从目标行为安装、通用能力保持与输出自然性三方面进行验证；作者据此重新审视已有生物体套件，并提出基于模型合并的多目标训练方法以构建更真实的模型生物体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型生物体（如后门、谄媚、伪相关）已成为评估白盒可解释性技术的关键工具，但当前普遍做法是仅以安装目标行为这一单一目标训练生物体，可能导致能力退化与输出不自然，从而使可解释性结论失真、难以泛化。

Method: 提出包含三项指标的三目标验证框架：目标行为安装、通用能力保持（参数化知识、对话质量）、输出自然性（CoT 与激活）。用该框架重新审视两个公开生物体套件；并引入基于模型合并（model merging）的多目标训练方法。同时构建一个针对临床推理中人口统计偏见的新生物体套件，对比监督微调与 DPO 等训练配方，并用调查者代理（investigator agent）进行审计。

Result: （1）跨训练配方，对话质量与 CoT 自然性显著退化；（2）验证指标可预测可解释性方法恢复目标行为的效果，例如 logit lens 读出与生物体的通用能力存在协变；（3）在新套件中，DPO 训练比监督微调更接近基座模型，所提模型优化方法更好地保持了能力与自然性；（4）审计显示验证指标同样能追踪偏见恢复情况。

Conclusion: 训练方法会塑造模型生物体所能支持的可解释性结论，因此应综合考虑多目标，才能基于（真实的）模型生物体对可解释性方法得出可泛化的结论。

Abstract: Model organisms of alignment-relevant behaviors (e.g., backdoors, sycophancy, spurious correlations) have emerged as a key tool for evaluating whitebox interpretability techniques. We argue that the prevailing practice of training model organisms to a single objective of installing the target behavior is insufficient and propose validating model organisms with respect to three objectives with associated metrics: target-behavior installation, general-capability preservation (i.e., parametric knowledge, chat quality), and output naturalness (i.e., CoT and activations). We re-visit two publicly released organism suites using this validation framework and show that (1) chat quality and CoT naturalness degrade substantially across training recipes, and (2) validation metrics predict how well interpretability methods recover the installed behavior, e.g., a logit lens readout covaries with an organism's general capabilities. We introduce a multi-objective training approach based on model merging to train more realistic model organisms. Finally, on a new suite of model organisms targeting demographic biases in clinical reasoning, we compare training recipes and find that DPO training stays closer to the base model than supervised finetuning, and the proposed model optimization approach better preserves capabilities and naturalness. Auditing this suite with an investigator agent, we again observe validation metrics tracking bias recovery. In sum, training methods shape the interpretability conclusions an organism supports, and we argue that one should consider multiple objectives to draw generalizable conclusions about interpretability methods using (realistic) model organisms.

</details>


### [404] [OrthoGen: A Generative Orthogonal Learner for Time-Varying Treatments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10210)
*Tomàs Garriga,Valentyn Melnychuk,Konstantin Hess,Eduard Serrahima de Cambra,Axel Brando,Gerard Sanz,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出生成式递归g-计算调整策略及正交生成学习器OrthoGen，用于在时变处理下估计条件分布型潜在结果，并具备双重稳健性与准预言效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随时间变化的条件分布型潜在结果（CDPOs）估计在医学中很重要（例如估计不同治疗序列下患者特异性风险），但时变混杂使该任务困难，且现有调整策略有限。

Method: (1) 提出面向该设定定制的调整策略——生成式递归g-计算，递归传播完整条件结果分布而非条件均值，直接建模关注变量而非完整轨迹，并据此构建简单的生成式学习器；(2) 针对其对 nuisance 估计误差敏感的问题，提出 OrthoGen，一种 Neyman 正交且双重稳健的生成式学习器，可实例化于归一化流、扩散模型等生成主干。

Result: 理论上证明 OrthoGen 在合适条件下实现速率双重稳健性和准预言效率；在合成、半合成与真实数据集实验中，OrthoGen 表现高度有效。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个用于时变处理下估计 CDPOs 的生成式正交学习器。

Abstract: Estimating conditional distributional potential outcomes (CDPOs) over time is important in medicine (e.g., to estimate patient-specific risks under different treatment sequences). However, this task is challenging because of time-varying confounding, yet existing adjustment strategies for this task are limited. In this paper, we aim to learn CDPOs under time-varying treatments using flexible generative models. Our contributions are two-fold. (1) We introduce a tailored adjustment strategy for our setting, namely, generative recursive g-computation. Our adjustment strategy recursively propagates full conditional outcome distributions rather than conditional means, modeling the variables of interest directly rather than full trajectories. Building on our adjustment strategy, we formulate simple generative learners for CDPO estimation. However, these learners can be sensitive to nuisance estimation errors, which motivates an orthogonal learner. (2) We thus introduce OrthoGen, a Neyman-orthogonal and doubly robust generative learner. Importantly, we show that OrthoGen further achieves rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency under suitable conditions. Our learners are flexible and can be instantiated with different generative backbones (e.g., normalizing flows and diffusion models). Across experiments with synthetic, semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, we find that OrthoGen is highly effective. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to propose a generative orthogonal learner for estimating CDPOs under time-varying treatments.

</details>


### [405] [Edge Accuracy Is Not Enough: Why Dynamics-Learned Structure Fails to Transfer to Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10213)
*Nicholas Tan Jerome,Fangnian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文证明：即使满足理论上的结构可迁移条件，从动力学预测中学习的关系结构在逆问题中仍会系统性失效，并提出一种轻量级的可迁移性检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆问题中标注数据稀缺，一种自然策略是迁移从大量前向仿真数据中学到的关系结构。然而作者发现该策略会系统性失败，即使它满足"结构应有帮助"的标准理论条件，因此需要揭示该失败机制并给出可预判的检验方法。

Method: 理论上，作者证明当边误差满足 Δ < n² − kn 时，近似结构带来估计误差收益，样本复杂度由 O(n²) 降至 O(kn+Δ)；并证明通过 NRI 从动力学预测学得的结构满足该条件。实验上，在 180 个 CFD 仿真氢气泄漏场景和 180 个声学场景的源定位任务上，对比 NRI 结构、任务优化注意力基线、物理先验（格林函数）及另两种动力学导出结构估计器（相关性和互信息），并做数据量、边阈值敏感性、图重叠度等四类消融。最后提出以 Jaccard 相似度对齐部分观测目标任务图的可迁移性检验。

Result: NRI 结构相对任务优化注意力基线使性能下降 116% 和 201%，物理先验仅下降 69–72%。四类证据排除调参问题：NRI 在 18 倍训练数据下仅提升 0.5%（基线提升 16.6%，p<0.001）；对边阈值不敏感；动力学学得图与任务最优图仅重合 6% 边；相关性和互信息估计器相对无结构基线无可测收益，相关性估计器明显更差。所提出的 Jaccard 检验在全部四组域/结构组合中均能区分成功与失败的迁移，计算耗时不到一小时，仅用目标域 15–20% 数据。

Conclusion: 结构可迁移性的边准确率条件无法控制真正的近似误差，这是理论条件与实际失败之间的缺口所在。作者将该缺口形式化为关于近似误差的命题，并提出一种基于 Jaccard 相似度的轻量级启发式可迁移性检验，但强调其仅在少量案例上校准，尚非经过验证的通用阈值。

Abstract: A natural strategy for inverse problems with scarce labelled data is to transfer relational structure learned from abundant forward-simulation data. We show this strategy fails systematically, even when it satisfies the standard theoretical justification for why structure should help. We prove that approximate structure provides estimation-error benefits whenever the edge error satisfies $Δ< n^2 - kn$, reducing sample complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(kn+Δ)$. Structure learned via Neural Relational Inference (NRI) from dynamics prediction satisfies this condition, yet on a source-localisation task across 180 CFD-simulated hydrogen-leak scenarios and 180 acoustic scenarios, it degrades performance by 116% and 201% relative to a flexible, task-optimised attention baseline, while a physics-based prior (Green's function) degrades by only 69-72%. Four independent lines of evidence show this is not a tuning failure: NRI improves only 0.5% when given 18x more training data (versus 16.6% for the task-optimised baseline, $p<0.001$); performance is insensitive to the NRI edge threshold across a wide range; the dynamics-learned graph overlaps the task-optimal graph on only 6% of edges; and two further dynamics-derived structure estimators (correlation- and mutual-information-based) show no measurable benefit over a structure-free baseline, with the correlation-based estimator performing markedly worse. We formalise this gap as a statement about approximation error that the edge-accuracy condition cannot control, and we provide a lightweight transferability test (Jaccard similarity against a partially-observed target-task graph) that separates successful from failed transfer in all four domain/structure pairs we evaluate, using under an hour of computation and 15-20% of target-domain data; we present this as a heuristic calibrated on few cases, not a validated general threshold.

</details>


### [406] [Finite-Sample Approximation of Hessian-Guided Perturbed Wasserstein Gradient Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10218)
*Ryotaro Kawata,Atsushi Nitanda,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带扰动的Wasserstein梯度流（PWGF）在非凸问题中逃离鞍点时的有限粒子近似精度，证明在沿参考路径累积曲率满足显式条件时，粒子与目标值跟踪界限在增长时间跨度上高概率成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wasserstein梯度流将梯度下降推广到概率测度空间，其Hessian引导的扰动变体PWGF通过注入高斯扰动来逃离非凸问题的鞍点。然而，当用有限多个相互作用粒子近似该流时，近似在增长时间跨度上是否仍然准确尚不清楚。作者希望刻画近似误差的长期行为，特别关注负曲率放大约束误差、后续正曲率抑制误差这一机制，从而识别"暂时不稳定但仍可长期准确跟踪"的有利场景。

Method: 保留沿群体驱动参考路径累积的曲率信息进行分析：负曲率可放大近似误差，后续正曲率可衰减其影响。在正则性假设和给定共同扰动计划下，针对满足累积曲率显式条件的参考路径，证明粒子与目标值的跟踪界限在高概率事件上成立。为处理状态依赖的高斯跳跃，构造"群体优先"耦合（population-first coupling），保持参考粒子的条件独立性，并将跳跃误差归结为协方差比较。最后在方差加余弦模型中验证条件，并在正则化矩阵分解模型中分析局部吸引、横向下降与正第二变分。

Result: 在方差加余弦模型中验证了所提条件，曲率恢复给出增长时间跨度的跟踪保证。在正则化矩阵分解模型中，确立了两个区域内的局部吸引、横向下降和正第二变分性质，从而支持一种正-负-正曲率模式。

Conclusion: 累积曲率是决定PWGF有限粒子近似长期精度的关键量：暂时的负曲率不稳定不必然破坏长期跟踪，只要后续正曲率能够充分衰减其影响。所构造的群体优先耦合为状态依赖高斯跳跃提供了有效的误差控制工具，矩阵分解模型中的正-负-正曲率模式为该机制提供了具体例证。

Abstract: Wasserstein gradient flow extends gradient descent to probability measures. Its Hessian-guided perturbed variant (PWGF) adds Gaussian perturbations to escape saddle points in nonconvex problems. We investigate when its approximation by finitely many interacting particles remains accurate over growing time horizons. Our analysis retains the curvature accumulated along the population-driven reference path: negative curvature can amplify approximation errors, while subsequent positive curvature can damp their influence. This captures favorable scenarios in which temporary instability is compatible with accurate tracking over growing horizons. Under regularity assumptions and a prescribed common perturbation schedule, we prove particle and objective-value tracking bounds on a high-probability event for reference paths satisfying explicit conditions on accumulated curvature. To handle state-dependent Gaussian jumps, we construct a population-first coupling that preserves the reference particles' conditional independence and reduces jump errors to covariance comparison. We verify the conditions in a variance-plus-cosine model, where curvature recovery yields a growing-horizon tracking guarantee. We also establish local attraction, transverse descent, and positive second variation in two regions of a regularized matrix-factorization model, motivating a positive-negative-positive curvature pattern.

</details>


### [407] [Evaluating Sequence Assembly Strategies for Differentially Private Synthetic Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10222)
*Guoxiong Long,Huizhen Huang,Qikun Cai,Tao Huang,Chen Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究差分隐私时间序列生成后“窗口拼接”过程，发现拼接方式对下游预测效用有显著且依赖具体预测模型的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私时间序列生成器通常只输出固定长度合成窗口，而下游预测模型需要长连续序列，因此生成之后的窗口拼接方式会改变呈现给预测器的有效合成数据，但该后处理环节此前缺乏系统研究。

Method: 系统改变窗口重叠率与窗口加权方案，对拼接所得序列从边界连续性、统计与时序保真度、以及TSTR预测效用三方面评估；在四类公开数据集（ETTh1、ETTm1、Weather、Appliances）和五种预测模型上进行完整五预测器拼接网格实验，并配以TRTR参考。

Result: 下游TSTR效用由预测器、重叠率、窗口加权方案共同决定，不同预测模型有各自的拼接偏好；增大重叠通常改善边界连续性，但连续性或单项保真度指标的提升并不总能降低预测误差；五预测器完整拼接网格与TRTR对照刻画了这些规律并量化了相对真实数据训练的拼接依赖效用。

Conclusion: 窗口拼接是差分隐私时间序列合成中不可忽视的后处理环节，拼接配置选择应以下游预测器实际效用为依据，而不能仅依赖连续性或单项保真度诊断；所得原则经稳健性与生成器变异性分析得到验证。

Abstract: Differentially private time-series generators commonly produce fixed-length synthetic windows, whereas downstream forecasting models often require long continuous training sequences. How these windows are assembled after generation can therefore alter the effective synthetic data presented to a forecaster, even when the trained generator remains unchanged. We study this post-generation sequence assembly process by systematically varying overlap rates and window-weighting schemes and evaluating the resulting sequences in terms of boundary continuity, statistical and temporal fidelity, and Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) forecasting utility. Across four types of public datasets (ETTh1, ETTm1, Weather, and Appliances) and five forecasting models, the results reveal a clear forecaster-dependent assembly principle: downstream TSTR utility is jointly shaped by the forecaster, overlap rate, and window-weighting scheme, leading to distinct assembly preferences across forecasting models. Increased overlap generally improves boundary continuity, but improvements in continuity or individual fidelity diagnostics do not consistently reduce forecasting error, indicating that these diagnostics alone are insufficient for selecting assembly configurations. Complete five-forecaster assembly grids, together with matched Train-on-Real-Test-on-Real (TRTR) references, further characterize these regularities and quantify assembly-dependent utility relative to real-data training. We then validate the identified principles through additional analyses of robustness and generator variability.

</details>


### [408] [From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10227)
*Yue Qiu,Zekang Du,Yiqun Diao,Bingsheng He,Qinbin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出在少样本场景下将LLM知识蒸馏到可解释决策树的框架，通过三阶段范式让LLM生成规则并组织成树，在真实表格数据集上兼顾精度与可解释性且提示开销更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM具备丰富世界知识与强泛化能力，但直接用于表格数据分类存在推理成本高、可解释性差的问题；决策树快速透明却在低数据量下性能不佳。作者希望结合二者优势。

Method: 在少样本学习设定下，将LLM知识蒸馏为可解释决策树。不直接提示LLM生成完整树（不稳定且低效），而是采用三阶段范式：提示LLM生成规则，再将规则组织为树。

Result: 在多个真实世界表格数据集上的实验表明，与现有基线相比，该方法取得了更优的准确率和可解释性，并显著降低了提示开销。

Conclusion: 该框架有效弥合LLM与决策树两类范式的差距，在少样本表格分类中实现精度、可解释性与效率的较好平衡。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.

</details>


### [409] [ProtocolMatch: Protocol-Dependent Model Selection for Scientific Dynamics Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10239)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将科学动力学预测从"架构选择"重构为"协议依赖的模型选择"问题，提出ProtocolMatch评估框架，在量子自旋动力学上揭示模型排序随训练集规模、观测历史、闭环反馈、物理约束与分布偏移而反转的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常把科学动力学预测简化为架构优劣之争，但实际部署效果还由观测历史长度、闭环反馈、算力预算、物理目标与测试分布共同决定，单看架构会得出误导性结论，因此需要协议一致的评估方法。

Method: 提出ProtocolMatch——一种算力匹配、验证集选择、保留失败样本的评估框架，用于协议依赖的模型选择。在驱动量子自旋动力学上，基于三个独立生成的数据集，比较循环网络、分块注意力、因果注意力和低秩线性预测器，并考察观测历史限制、状态刷新/闭环视图、物理惩罚与频率偏移等条件。

Result: 在固定双自旋任务中，随训练集增大，因果注意力与循环网络的排序发生反转；六自旋局部可观测量比较中线性预测器平均误差最低；限制观测历史使所有刷新历史视图变差，却使四自旋研究中所有闭环视图改善；最新状态MLP在全部五个单元、所有数据集上刷新状态下误差低于持久性基线，但其闭环排名随系统变化并出现有限爆炸误差；物理惩罚提升目标一致性但不稳定改善预测误差；驱动频率偏移后同分布区间大多失去覆盖率。

Conclusion: 科学模型选择应把预测器与其评估协议绑定返回，并分别报告预测精度、物理有效性与分布偏移下的可靠性，而非仅以架构或单一误差指标下结论。

Abstract: Scientific dynamics forecasting is often framed as an architecture choice, although deployment is also determined by observed history, rollout feedback, compute budget, physical objective, and test distribution. We formulate protocol-dependent model selection and introduce ProtocolMatch, a compute-matched, validation-selected, and failure-preserving evaluation framework. On driven quantum-spin dynamics, we compare recurrent, patched-attention, causal-attention, and low-rank linear predictors across three independently generated datasets. The causal-attention--recurrence ordering reverses as the training set grows within a fixed two-spin task, while a linear predictor has the lowest mean error in the six-spin local-observable comparison. Restricting observed history worsens every refreshed-history view but improves every closed-loop view in the four-spin study. A latest-state MLP has lower error than persistence on every dataset under state refresh across all five cells, yet its closed-loop rank varies by system and includes finite explosive errors. Physical penalties improve targeted consistency without reliably improving prediction error, and in-distribution intervals lose most coverage after a driving-frequency shift. Thus scientific model selection should return a predictor with its protocol and report accuracy, physical validity, and shifted-distribution reliability separately.

</details>


### [410] [MorphCL: Morphological Contrastive Learning for Inertial-based Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10245)
*Marius Bock,Yuwei Zhang,Juergen Gall,Michael Moeller,Kristof Van Laerhoven,Cecilia Mascolo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MorphCL，一种利用结构感知分组（motion motifs 与领域特征描述子）将全局结构建模注入惯性数据自监督预训练的框架，显著提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴与移动设备传感器普及，产生大量人体运动数据，但将无标注记录转化为基础运动模型仍是难题。自监督学习虽减少了对昂贵标注的依赖，但现有方法依赖随机采样批次与局部对比，未充分利用大规模运动数据的全局结构；在真实野外惯性数据中，静止、低方差行为占主导，这一问题尤为突出。

Method: 提出 Morphological Contrastive Learning（MorphCL）：基于运动分析两大支柱——运动基元（motifs）发现与领域特定特征描述子——采用结构感知分组（structure-aware grouping），将全局结构的显式建模注入基于惯性数据的自监督学习框架中。

Result: MorphCL 使学习到的编码器在线性探测与微调上 F1-score 提升最高达 15 个百分点；与现有基础模型相比，MorphCL 预训练编码器在线性探测性能上持平或超越，而训练数据量少 4600 倍；嵌入空间的定性分析显示具有形态学意义的聚类结构，运动学相似的活动类别分离度更好。

Conclusion: 通过结构感知分组显式建模全局结构，可有效提升惯性运动数据自监督预训练的表征质量与数据效率，并带来形态学上有意义的嵌入结构。

Abstract: Despite the ubiquity of sensors in wearable and mobile devices and the abundance of human movement data they generate, translating unlabeled recordings into foundational motion models remains an open challenge. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has alleviated the need for costly annotations, yet existing approaches leave the global structure of large-scale motion data largely untapped, relying on randomly sampled batches and local comparisons that become particularly problematic for in-the-wild inertial data dominated by stationary, low-variance behaviors. Here we introduce Morphological Contrastive Learning (MorphCL), a self-supervised pretraining framework that uses structure-aware grouping to inject explicit modeling of global structure into inertial-based SSL approaches. Building on two well-established pillars of motion analysis, the discovery of motion primitives, or motifs, and domain-specific feature descriptors, we show that MorphCL substantially improves linear probing and finetuning results of learned encoders by up to 15 percentage points in F1-score. In a comparison with existing foundation models, we demonstrate that MorphCL-pretrained encoders match or surpass them models in linear probing performance while trained on $4600\times$ less data. Qualitative analysis of the resulting embedding spaces further reveals morphologically meaningful cluster structure, with improved separation of kinematically similar activity classes.

</details>


### [411] [Stationary Bias and Extrapolation in Nonlinear Two-Timescale Stochastic Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10246)
*A. Ch. Madhusudanarao,Rahul Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究由外生有限状态马尔可夫链驱动的非线性双时间尺度随机逼近中的常数步长稳态偏差，推导慢步长远小于快步长时一致有效的首阶偏差展开，揭示 ε²/η 混合项及步长幂律路径下非整数偏差指数对标度匹配的 Richardson–Romberg 外推的要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常数步长随机逼近存在不可通过时间平均消除的稳态均值误差。双时间尺度设定下快、慢步长的耦合使该偏差对两者依赖复杂，尤其在慢步长远小于快步长的极限下偏差期望的渐近刻画与偏差缩减方法（如 Richardson–Romberg 外推）缺乏理论依据。

Method: 在给定光滑性假设与平稳分布条件下，对非线性双时间尺度递推推导首阶偏差展开，并证明慢步长趋于远小于快步长时误差界保持一致。引入快流形坐标使协方差方程在该极限下保持正则，从而得到 ε²/η 混合项与各步长线性项；随后用幂律步长路径分析偏差指数，并研究尾部平均初始化误差界。

Result: 偏差展开包含 ε²/η 混合贡献与各步长的线性项；在幂律步长路径下偏差指数不必为整数，故 Richardson–Romberg 外推需使用与路径匹配的权重。一个可精确求解的非线性马尔可夫例子验证了系数；在时序差分学习中验证了局部化，并在等更新预算下比较有限次运行的外推效果。有限次运行下，在附加耦合假设下给出两个时间尺度上尾部平均初始化误差界；在加性独立噪声特例中，三阶矩符号相消给出更精细的余项。

Conclusion: 双时间尺度常数步长随机逼近的稳态偏差不能简单视为各步长线性效应之和，ε²/η 混合项在慢快步长分离时起关键作用。偏差缩减需要依据步长路径定制外推权重，可解例子与 TD 学习实验支持该展开；附加耦合假设下的初始化误差界与加性噪声情形下的三阶矩相消进一步刻画了有限运行与更精细余项行为。

Abstract: Constant-step stochastic approximation generally has a nonzero stationary mean error that persists under time averaging. This paper studies that error for nonlinear two-timescale recursions driven by an exogenous finite-state Markov chain. Under stated smoothness assumptions and conditions on the stationary distribution, we derive a first-order bias expansion whose error bound remains uniform as the slow step size becomes much smaller than the fast step size. Fast-manifold coordinates keep the associated covariance equation regular in this limit. For fast step $η$ and slow step $\varepsilon$, the expansion reveals a mixed contribution $\varepsilon^2/η$ alongside terms linear in each step size. This dependence matters for bias reduction: along power-law step-size paths, the bias exponents need not be integers, so Richardson--Romberg extrapolation requires weights matched to the path. An exactly solvable nonlinear Markov example verifies the coefficients. We verify localization for temporal-difference learning and compare finite-run extrapolation at equal update budgets. For finite runs, we bound the initialization error of tail averages on both timescales under an additional coupling assumption. In the special case of additive independent noise, signed third-moment cancellation yields a sharper remainder.

</details>


### [412] [Logarithmic Regret via Passive Change Detection in Piecewise-Stationary Self-Tuning Regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10250)
*A. Ch. Madhusudanarao,Rahul Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究带外生输入、参数在未知时刻变化的自回归系统的最小方差控制，在扰动有界、检测间隔固定、稳定性与可行性成立且变化间有足够时间的条件下，提出PIECE-CD算法，证明以概率至少1-δ取得O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ))遗憾，其中T为时域、C为变化次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有切换bandit问题中未被选择的臂可在无观测下变化，而本文关注的是admissible plant changes在利用（exploitation）阶段仍能提供信息：正确可行控制器下输出仅含扰动，可检测的变化会在旧控制器下抬高输出能量。作者希望在此类可观测变化结构下实现最小方差控制，并刻画遗憾与检测延迟。

Method: 提出PIECE-CD：初始阶段与每次报警后进行探索，其余时间用gated recursive least squares进行控制；采用能量检验，将窗口输出功率与高于噪声底限的阈值比较；针对不稳定控制器失配，进一步监控参考控制器的输入建议；在整个时域上控制误报，并证明对数级检测延迟；对输入做clipping至规定边界，并给出使clipping在有限burn-in后不再活跃的显式条件。

Result: 在所述可行性条件下，算法以至少1-δ概率获得O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ))遗憾；实现对数级检测延迟并控制全程误报；扩展检测器在固定窗口内覆盖具有可检测超额能量的失稳性变化；在显式条件下，clipping在有限burn-in后不活跃时仍保持对数遗憾。

Conclusion: 该类可观测参数变化的最小方差控制可达到对数遗憾与对数检测延迟；能量阈值检验结合门控RLS与探索/报警后的重启策略是关键；输入clipping与失稳检测的扩展在给定条件下不破坏理论保证。

Abstract: We study minimum-variance control of an unknown autoregressive system with exogenous inputs and coefficients that change at unknown times. Under bounded independent disturbances, fixed detection gaps, stability and feasibility conditions, and sufficient time between changes, we prove \(O((C+1)\log((T+1)/δ))\) regret with probability at least \(1-δ\), where \(T\) is the horizon and \(C\) the number of changes. Unlike switching bandits, where unselected arms can change unobserved, admissible plant changes provide information during exploitation: the correct feasible controller leaves only the disturbance in the output, whereas a detectable change raises output energy under the old controller. PIECE-CD explores initially and after alarms, then uses gated recursive least squares for control. Its energy test compares windowed output power with a threshold above the noise floor; the extension to unstable controller mismatches also monitors the reference controller's input proposal. We control false alarms across the horizon and prove logarithmic detection delay. Inputs are clipped to prescribed bounds. Logarithmic regret also holds under an explicit condition ensuring that clipping becomes inactive after a finite burn-in. Under the stated feasibility conditions, the extended detector covers destabilizing changes with detectable excess energy over a fixed window.

</details>


### [413] [PairAudit: Guiding Human Review with Graph Tokens under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10260)
*Jiran Tao,Binyan Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PairAudit 通过图令牌捕获节点间预测模式，利用异常关系模式发现被忽视的误分类，并在固定预算下借助人工反馈调整复审优先级，从而比基于不确定性的复审纠错更多，且无需重训练检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 入侵检测器会对训练中未见的攻击作出高置信度误判；人工复审可纠错但受预算限制。基于不确定性的复审会漏掉高置信度错误，而仅靠异常分数无法判断改变复审计划是否能纠正更多错误。

Method: 提出 PairAudit：其图令牌（graph tokens）捕获相连节点间的预测模式；不通过特征聚合构建新预测器，而是利用异常的关系模式揭示现有预测中的潜在错误；再由人工反馈决定这些发现是否足以调整复审优先级。

Result: 在多个安全任务上的实验表明，PairAudit 平均比基于不确定性的复审纠正更多错误，包括对未见过攻击的错误；这些收益已计入全部复审成本，且无需重训练检测器。

Conclusion: PairAudit 在固定复审预算下能发现被忽视的错误并优化复审，效果优于不确定性方法，且在计入复审成本、不重训练检测器的前提下仍成立。

Abstract: Intrusion detectors can confidently misclassify attacks that were not seen during training. Human review can correct these errors, but only a limited number of cases can be checked. Uncertainty-based review may overlook confident errors, while anomaly scores alone do not show whether changing the review plan will correct more errors. We introduce PairAudit to find overlooked errors and improve review under a fixed budget. Its graph tokens capture prediction patterns across connected nodes. Rather than building another predictor through feature aggregation, PairAudit uses unusual relational patterns to uncover potential errors in existing predictions. Human feedback then helps decide whether these findings justify changing review priorities. Experiments across security tasks show that PairAudit corrects more errors on average than uncertainty-based review, including more errors on unseen attacks. These gains account for all review costs and do not require retraining the detector.

</details>


### [414] [A Closed-Loop Non-Asymptotic Convergence Analysis of PPO with Learned Critics and Clipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10273)
*Junwei Su,Mengfan Liu,Yanyong Zhang,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对PPO-Clip作为闭环actor–critic系统进行了非渐近分析，刻画了actor–critic耦合、非光滑概率比裁剪、有限批复用与可预测早停，并在同步与异步设定下给出策略平稳性与critic跟踪精度的显式界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPO-Clip应用广泛但难以调参，其critic学习、裁剪与rollout复用之间的相互作用尚未被充分理解，缺乏刻画这些耦合机制的理论分析。

Method: 将PPO-Clip建模为闭环actor–critic系统，在显式覆盖与critic正则性假设下进行非渐近分析；采用原始GAE与蒙特卡洛critic目标，分别给出同步与异步保证；提出充分耦合条件统一放大界并给出异步的延迟相关critic步长限制。对分层有限MDP与表格critic，用裁剪梯度类的均匀界替代完整轨迹计数。

Result: 同步与异步结果联合刻画策略平稳性与critic跟踪精度且显式依赖算法参数；存在验证过的增长时域族具有多项式样本复杂度；双时间尺度调度下达到O(T^{-2/5})的策略平稳性与critic跟踪界，并显式计入新rollout开销。

Conclusion: 结果为PPO的调参提供了理论指导，加深了对裁剪、critic学习与批复用交互机制的理解，同时给出了明确的收敛速率与样本复杂度保证。

Abstract: Despite its widespread use, Proximal Policy Optimization with clipping (PPO-Clip) remains difficult to tune, and the interactions among critic learning, clipping, and rollout reuse remain incompletely understood. We develop a \emph{non-asymptotic} analysis of PPO-Clip as a \emph{closed-loop actor--critic} system. It captures actor--critic coupling, nonsmooth probability-ratio clipping, finite-batch reuse, and predictable early stopping under explicit coverage and critic regularity assumptions, using raw GAE and Monte Carlo critic targets. Our synchronous and asynchronous guarantees jointly characterize policy stationarity and the tracking accuracy of the learned critic, with explicit dependence on algorithmic parameters. A sufficient coupling condition gives optimization, critic tracking, clipping, and finite-batch errors a common amplification bound. The asynchronous result also requires a delay-dependent critic stepsize restriction; violating these conditions does not establish divergence. For finite layered MDPs with tabular critics, a uniform bound on the actual clipped-gradient class replaces complete-trajectory counting. A verified growing-horizon family has polynomial sample complexity, and a two-time-scale schedule gives $O(T^{-2/5})$ stationarity and critic-tracking bounds with explicit fresh-rollout accounting. These results together advance our understanding about PPO and provide theoretical guidance in tuning.

</details>


### [415] [Sparse Planning in Visual World Models via Cost Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10274)
*Yingchen Xu,Edward Grefenstette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练、目标条件化的空间token选择器COSTGRAD，依据规划代价对各输入token的梯度范数排序选择token，在AdaLN预测器50%稀疏度下匹配或超越全token规划，实测每步规划约2.6倍加速，结合缩减CEM搜索可达约5倍总加速，并揭示选择器与架构兼容性的失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于token的世界模型支持细粒度隐空间规划，但反复处理大规模空间token网格导致动作搜索代价高昂，需要一种高效且面向规划目标的token筛选方法。

Method: COSTGRAD为免训练、目标条件化的选择器，通过计算规划代价对每个输入token的梯度范数来对空间token排序，从而以控制目标而非预测目标来度量token重要性，实现稀疏token规划。

Result: 在AdaLN条件化预测器、50%稀疏度下，COSTGRAD在四个连续控制基准中的三个匹配或超过全token规划，每环境规划步实测2.6倍墙钟加速；结合token稀疏与缩减CEM搜索可达约5倍总加速且仍优于全token基线。此外发现架构依赖性失效模式：在AdaLN与concat的对照中，concat保持相当的全token性能，但纯COSTGRAD相较随机选择失去优势，该差异与动作路径漂移相关——AdaLN上梯度选择移除的漂移小于随机移除，concat上则更大。

Conclusion: 选择器与架构的兼容性是稀疏世界模型规划的重要设计轴，COSTGRAD在AdaLN类预测器上有效，但其收益依赖架构条件。

Abstract: Token-based world models enable fine-grained latent planning, but repeatedly processing large spatial token grids makes action search expensive. We introduce COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens by the gradient norm of the planning cost with respect to each input token. By deriving importance from the downstream control objective, COSTGRAD targets tokens that matter for planning rather than merely for prediction. On AdaLN-conditioned predictors at $50\%$ sparsity, COSTGRAD matches or exceeds full-token planning on three of four continuous-control benchmarks, while giving a measured $2.6\times$ wall-clock speedup per environment planning step. Combining token sparsity with reduced CEM search increases this to a $\sim 5\times$ total speedup while still exceeding the full-token baseline. We also identify an architecture-dependent failure mode: in a matched AdaLN-vs-concat comparison, concat maintains comparable full-token performance but pure COSTGRAD loses its advantage over random selection.
