This difference tracks action-pathway drift: gradient-selected removal produces less drift than random removal on AdaLN, but more on concat. These results highlight selector-architecture compatibility as a design axis for sparse world-model planning. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/

</details>


### [416] [PatchBench: Measuring Collateral Damage in Activation Patching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10276)
*Alexi Canesse,Mathis Le Bail,Maël Jenny,Clément Elliker,Mahammed El Sharkawy,Sonia Vanier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PatchBench（含 400 条高置信度越狱失败样本）与 PatchBench-Local 评估协议，通过生成局部邻居提示来区分"精准修复"与"过度局部抑制"，揭示聚合指标掩盖的附带损伤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全补丁可能仅通过基准测试却并非真正修复：对越狱的修复目标是在不改变无关行为的前提下纠正特定不安全行为。然而，补丁可能只拦住精确评估提示却在相近有害变体上失效，或通过过度拒绝措辞/结构相似的良性提示来压制有害行为。现有协议主要测试模型能否被攻破，而攻击成功率、拒绝率、全局能力等聚合指标无法区分选择性修复与更广泛的局部抑制。

Method: 1) 从 37 个公开数据集的 27,870 条提示出发，整理出 15,314 条英文提示，查询 8 个开源指令微调模型；结合 WildGuard 过滤、成对 Elo 排序与人工核验，保留 400 条高置信度越狱失败样本构成 PatchBench。2) 提出 PatchBench-Local 评估协议：对每条有害源提示生成三类局部邻居——保持恶意意图的有害变体、结构匹配的良性提示、复用关键有害词项的良性提示；据此评估有害邻居纠正率与良性邻居保持率，区分选择性修复与广泛局部抑制。3) 用 PatchBench-Local 与 MMLU 评估四种激活导向方法。

Result: 评估四种激活导向方法发现：全局能力几乎不变的同时，局部良性回归却十分严重，证实聚合指标会遗漏重要的附带损伤。

Conclusion: PatchBench-Local 为开发与比较越狱修复方法提供了更精确的基础，能够识别聚合指标无法捕捉的局部附带损伤。

Abstract: An LLM safety patch can pass a benchmark while still being a poor repair. This risk is especially acute for jailbreak repairs, where the goal is to correct a specific unsafe behaviour without changing unrelated behaviours. A patch may block exact evaluation prompts yet fail on close harmful variants, or suppress harmful behaviour by over-refusing benign prompts that share its wording or structure. Existing protocols primarily test whether models can be broken, while aggregate metrics (attack success, refusal rates, global capability) cannot distinguish selective repairs from broader local suppression. To address this gap, we introduce PatchBench, a benchmark of empirically observed model-specific jailbreak failures inducing actionable harmful answers. Starting from 27,870 prompts from 37 public datasets, we curate 15,314 English prompts and query 8 open-source instruction-tuned models. Combining WildGuard filtering, pairwise Elo ranking, and manual verification, we retain a curated bank of 400 high-confidence jailbreak failures. We further introduce PatchBench-Local, an evaluation protocol testing whether a patch is behaviourally precise. For each harmful source prompt, PatchBench-Local generates three families of local neighbours: harmful variants preserving malicious intent, benign prompts with matched structure, and benign prompts reusing key harmful terms. It evaluates harmful-neighbour correction and benign-neighbour preservation, distinguishing selective repair from broader local suppression. Evaluating four activation steering methods with PatchBench-Local and MMLU shows that global capability can remain nearly unchanged while local benign regressions are severe, confirming aggregate metrics miss important collateral damage. PatchBench-Local provides a more precise basis for developing and comparing jailbreak repair methods.

</details>


### [417] [Physics-Aligned Electronic Ground-State Learning Improves Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10298)
*Eike S. Eberhard,Xaver Kainz,Viktor Kotsev,Abdulrahman Aldossary,Stephan Günnemann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可观测无关的电子基态描述符模型（GSM），通过ON-Loss、GROOT、ROCKET等物理约束设计，在保持介于MLIP与KS-DFT之间计算成本的前提下，大幅提升外分布泛化精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）在分布内任务表现优异，但外分布泛化能力差。作者希望在MLIPs与Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（KS-DFT）之间的计算成本区间内，推动成本-精度帕累托前沿。

Method: 设计可观测无关的电子基态描述符模型（GSMs），使学习目标与架构对齐KS-DFT控制方程：通过施加物理约束、消除对非物理或无关自由度的优化压力。具体贡献包括OrthoNormal-Loss（ON-Loss）、Grassmann Restricted Occupied-Orbital Training（GROOT）以及Residual Optimal-gauge Conditioning-aware KS-Eq. Training（ROCKET）。

Result: 在QM9到QM40的尺寸外推实验中，ON-Loss+GROOT使密度GSM的能量与力MAE相比此前最优分别降低79.1%和83.4%；ON-Loss+ROCKET使Hamiltonian GSM的能量与力MAE相比最强基线分别降低99.8%和95.9%。在QMugs上使用自洽拒绝准则，剔除不到0.4%的预测即达到0.07 mHa的能量MAE。此外展示了无标签自洽微调的高效性，并将GSM迁移至Transition1x反应化学，能量误差低于化学精度。

Conclusion: 通过将学习目标与KS-DFT控制方程对齐并施加物理约束，GSM在成本-精度权衡与外分布泛化上显著优于现有方法，且具备自洽误差过滤、无标签微调与反应化学迁移能力。

Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) excel at in-distribution tasks, accelerating drug and material development, yet they struggle to generalize out-of-distribution. We propose to push the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier by designing observable-agnostic electronic ground-state descriptor models (GSMs) with computational costs situated between MLIPs and Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT). We align the learning objectives and architectures of GSMs with the governing equations of KS-DFT by enforcing physical constraints and removing optimization pressure on unphysical or irrelevant degrees of freedom. In our size-extrapolation experiments from QM9 to QM40, our combined contributions OrthoNormal-Loss (ON-Loss) and Grassmann Restricted Occupied-Orbital Training (GROOT) reach a 79.1% energy and 83.4% force mean absolute error (MAE) reduction over previous state-of-the-art density GSMs. For Hamiltonian GSMs, ON-Loss and Residual Optimal-gauge Conditioning-aware KS-Eq. Training (ROCKET) together reduce the energy and force MAEs of the strongest baseline by 99.8% and 95.9%, respectively. Using a self-consistency rejection criterion, we filter out extrapolation errors on QMugs, rejecting fewer than 0.4% of predictions while reaching an energy MAE of 0.07 mHa. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency of label-free self-consistency fine-tuning, and transfer GSMs to reactive chemistry in Transition1x, reaching energy errors below chemical accuracy.

</details>


### [418] [Shared Gaussianization: What Gaussian Regularizers Certify About Contrastive Learning, and What They Miss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10299)
*Ruoyu Zhao,Yuting Chen,Jinheng Zhang,Zhehao Zou,Tong Che*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出共享高斯化(SG)正则化器,将两路归一化视图的平均作为特征函数高斯性检验对象并用独立χ_d半径缩放,可同时检测未对齐与非均匀性:它在总体InfoNCE的均匀对齐极小点处归零,并以√SG损失形式给出InfoNCE超额界,且该速率与维度无关常数是尖锐的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机是厘清SIGReg等分布匹配正则化器(如LeJEPA中)究竟能为对比学习提供何种理论保证,即能否同时约束视图对齐与特征均匀性,以及在何种条件下能控制InfoNCE目标。

Method: 以两个归一化视图均值的特征函数高斯性检验构造SG正则器,用独立χ_d半径缩放;推导InfoNCE超额的上下界;分析该检验是否成为InfoNCE核谱的主导;并在各向同性nuisance通道、有限批量U统计量及受控隐变量模型下研究优化动态。

Result: SG在总体InfoNCE的均匀对齐极小点处精确为零;等边际下InfoNCE超额以4·3^{3/4}β乘以√SG损失(加线性项)为上界,√速率与维度无关常数尖锐,视图对上的平方均值嵌入距离无法达到更快速率;若附加显式对齐项,旋转不变均匀性检验给出线性界当且仅当其谱主导InfoNCE核e^{βu^⊤v},SG自身检验满足,高斯核e^{-γ‖u-v‖²}当γ≥β/2时成立,矩匹配永不成立;非最优处目标不同,纯SG可通过增加逐视图nuisance降低损失(当共享码非均匀时),对齐权重大于通道增益时无nuisance解为严格局部极小;LeJEPA存在随批量减小而变化的临界SIGReg权重;有限批量下采用非对角U统计量可消除偏向未对齐的插件偏差;受控模型中纯SG保留逐视图风格,适当对齐权重可去除,实测增益可区分是否保留风格的编码器;InfoNCE训练比从头SG_{0.2}训练达到更低的SG_{0.2}损失,提示存在优化间隙。

Conclusion: SG提供了一种统一检验对齐与均匀性的正则化视角,能以尖锐速率约束InfoNCE超额,但其理论保证依赖显式对齐项与核谱条件;纯SG在非最优处可能与对比目标不一致,需谨慎设定对齐权重与批量大小。

Abstract: What can a distribution-matching regularizer such as SIGReg in LeJEPA certify about contrastive learning? We study shared Gaussianization (SG), a characteristic-function Gaussianity test on the average of two normalized views, scaled by an independent $χ_d$ radius. Because disagreeing views shorten the average, one test detects both misalignment and non-uniformity. SG vanishes exactly at the aligned, uniform minimizers of population InfoNCE, and under equal marginals it bounds the InfoNCE excess by $4\cdot 3^{3/4}β$ times the square root of the SG loss, plus a term linear in the loss. The square-root rate and this dimension-free constant are sharp, and no squared mean-embedding distance on view pairs achieves a faster rate. With an explicit alignment term, a rotation-invariant uniformity test gives a linear bound if and only if its spectrum dominates that of InfoNCE's kernel $e^{βu^\top v}$; SG's own test does, Gaussian kernels $e^{-γ\|u-v\|^2}$ qualify exactly when $γ\ge β/2$, and moment matching never does. Away from the optimum, the objectives differ. Along an isotropic nuisance channel, pure SG lowers its loss by adding per-view nuisance whenever the shared code is non-uniform. An alignment weight above the channel's gain makes the nuisance-free solution a strict local minimizer; for LeJEPA, the same rule gives a critical SIGReg weight that decreases with the batch size. At finite batch size, an off-diagonal U-statistic removes a plug-in bias toward misalignment. In controlled latent-variable models, pure SG retains per-view style, an alignment weight above the measured gain removes it, and for LeJEPA at three batch sizes the measured gain separates the encoders that retain style from those that do not. InfoNCE training also reaches a lower SG$_{0.2}$ loss than SG$_{0.2}$ training from scratch, which points to an optimization gap.

</details>


### [419] [Revisiting Explainable AI through Model-Independent Concept Dictionaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10301)
*Thomas Schnake,Doreen Schöppenthau,Alexander Meyer,Jacques Corbeil,Klaus-Robert Müller,Grégoire Montavon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DictXAI 通过在输入域中定义可解释的字典元素，将模型预测归因到稀疏编码对应的字典元素上，实现可解释、可操作且与架构无关的 XAI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 XAI 方法通常假设输入特征本身可解释，或依赖难以刻画且高度依赖具体架构的内部中间抽象，导致跨模型一致性差，限制了通用性。

Method: DictXAI 直接在输入域中用字典（一个大规模、可能过完备的预定义元素集合，每个元素带可解释含义）定义概念；先计算输入的稀疏编码，再将模型预测归因到相关字典元素。

Result: DictXAI 能将 AI 故障（如 Clever Hans 效应）直接归因到数据中可识别的伪影模式，并在复杂生物医学信号上促进人机对齐；可跨多种字典工作，包括学习到的图像基、心电图的解析定义波形以及实验获取的字典元素。

Conclusion: 相比经典 XAI 或已有基于概念的方法，DictXAI 提供更可解释、更可操作且架构无关的洞察。

Abstract: Modern applications of AI rely on increasingly complex models. Explainable AI (XAI) has emerged as a set of techniques aimed at improving model transparency. However, existing XAI methods typically assume input features to be inherently interpretable, or they rely on intermediate internal abstractions that are difficult to characterize and highly architecture-specific, hindering consistent use across models. To address these limitations, we propose DictXAI, a method that defines concepts directly in the input domain via a dictionary---a large, potentially overcomplete set of predefined elements, each carrying an interpretable meaning. Technically, DictXAI first computes a sparse code of the input and then attributes the model's prediction to the associated dictionary elements. We demonstrate the actionable nature of DictXAI explanations, showing that they can attribute AI malfunctions (e.g., Clever Hans effects) directly to identifiable artifact patterns in the data, while fostering human-AI alignment on intricate biomedical signals. We further demonstrate our method's ability to operate across a wide variety of dictionaries, including learned image bases, analytically defined waveforms for electrocardiography, and experimentally acquired dictionary elements. Overall, our results show that DictXAI provides more interpretable, actionable, and architecture-agnostic insights than classical XAI or existing concept-based approaches.

</details>


### [420] [Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10302)
*Tommaso Marzi,Ahmed Hendawy,Jan Peters,Carlo D'Eramo,Andrea Cini,Cesare Alippi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CGMARL框架，将连续多智能体强化学习任务序列建模为属性图，并给出基准GRAFO与冻结图编码器FROG方法，实验表明FROG能显著提升性能并缓解遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CMARL方法缺乏利用任务间结构差异（如电网拓扑、编队构型）的专门机制，难以促进知识迁移并缓解灾难性遗忘。

Method: 提出CGMARL框架：将任务序列映射为一系列属性图，每张图决定环境动态（下一状态/奖励）与智能体数量；构建首个CGMARL基准GRAFO；提出FROG方法，利用冻结的图主干网络在图式CMARL策略中保留既往结构信息。

Result: 在GRAFO上的实验表明，将FROG与现有持续学习方法结合，在多个CGMARL场景中显著提升性能。

Conclusion: 结构化的图建模为连续多智能体强化学习提供了有效的问题表述与缓解遗忘的手段，FROG与通用持续学习方法的组合具备良好迁移性与通用性。

Abstract: In Continual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CMARL), agents learn cooperative policies across sequences of tasks, aiming to adapt effectively to new tasks while preserving the ability to solve previously encountered ones. In many applications, tasks differ in their underlying structure, which can represent, for example, distinct operational conditions or target configurations (e.g., different network topologies in power grids or arrangements in formation control). Existing CMARL methods lack dedicated mechanisms to leverage this structural information when learning new tasks, failing to promote transfer and mitigate forgetting. To fill this gap, we propose Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CGMARL), a novel framework for CMARL problems in which task sequences are mapped into a series of attributed graphs, each modeling a task-specific structure. In CGMARL, each graph determines the environment dynamics (next states and/or rewards) and the number of agents for the corresponding task. Then, we present Graph-based Formation (GRAFO), the first CGMARL benchmark, and show how forgetting arises in this setting. Finally, to address this limitation, we propose Frozen Graph Encoder (FROG), a method that relies on a frozen graph backbone to preserve past structural information in graph-based CMARL policies. Experiments on GRAFO show that pairing FROG with existing CL methods substantially improves performance on multiple CGMARL scenarios.

</details>


### [421] [SemanticFold: Latent Sequence Compression SeparatesLanguage Modeling, Decodability, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10304)
*Mingyan Liu,Min Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SemanticFold——一种在学习到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态的潜在序列压缩方案，并在五个模型规模上通过固定目标协议评估其五项端点族。核心发现：压缩对各项端点的影响非单调，且不存在统一的压缩阈值；潜在压缩下的能力保持没有单一标量证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究提示前缀的潜在序列压缩是否会保留大模型推理所依赖的能力，并检验能否用单一指标（如似然）来"证明"压缩无害。此前研究常以单一标量衡量压缩保真度，本文质疑这一做法。

Method: 提出 SemanticFold：在学习到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态。在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B、SmolLM2-1.7B、Pythia-1.4B、Pythia-6.9B 五个规模上评估。采用固定目标协议：冻结前缀以原生或压缩方式执行，两条臂对相同续写 token 做 teacher-forcing，从而排除目标选择对似然变化的解释。考察五类端点：固定目标负对数似然、有限标签推理准确率、线性探针可解码性、开放式生成、系统级显存与延迟。另设 MLP-only 变体（仅施加残差变换不做缩短）进行分解对照。

Result: 端点随压缩非单调变化且不共享同一压缩阈值。Qwen3-1.7B 在 R=1.7 时，配对 bootstrap（10000 次抽样）下压缩减原生的平均 NLL 降低 0.135；SmolLM2 在 R=1.2 时平均变化比原生高 0.013；两个 Pythia 检查点 NLL 基本不变。NLL 分解显示 Qwen 的有利似然主要归因于残差适配而非单纯序列缩短；仅 MLP（不缩短）的 NLL 比 Full SemanticFold 低 0.082。线性探针准确率与 macro AUC 在各条件下绝对变化小于 0.03，置信区间跨零。

Conclusion: 潜在压缩下的能力保持不存在单一标量证书：语言模型拟合度、可解码性与推理行为回答不同问题，在同一压缩操作下可能朝不同方向变化。

Abstract: We study whether latent sequence compression of prompt prefixes preserves the capabilities that large language models rely on during inference. We introduce SemanticFold, a compression scheme that folds prefix hidden states at learned boundaries, and evaluate it across five model scales: Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-8B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Pythia-1.4B, and Pythia-6.9B. We use a fixed-target protocol: a frozen prefix is executed natively or compressed, and both arms teacher-force identical continuation tokens. This design rules out target-selection explanations for likelihood changes. We examine five endpoint families: fixed-target negative log-likelihood, finite-label reasoning accuracy, linear probe accessibility, open-ended generation, and systems-level memory and latency. We find that compression moves these endpoints non-monotonically and that they do not share a single compression threshold. On Qwen3-1.7B at compression ratio R=1.7, compressed-minus-native mean NLL decreases by 0.135 under paired bootstrap with 10000 draws. On SmolLM2 at R=1.2, the mean change is 0.013 higher than native. On both Pythia checkpoints, NLL is effectively unchanged. An NLL decomposition separating sequence shortening from the learned residual transform shows that the favorable Qwen likelihood is attributable primarily to residual adaptation rather than to shortening alone. MLP-only, which applies the transform without shortening, achieves 0.082 lower NLL than Full SemanticFold. Linear probe accuracy and macro AUC change by less than 0.03 in absolute value across conditions, with confidence intervals crossing zero. We conclude that preservation under latent compression has no single scalar certificate: language-model fit, decodability, and reasoning behavior answer different questions and can move in different directions under the same compression operation.

</details>


### [422] [How Do Transformers Learn to Represent Symmetries?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10305)
*Eduardo Santos-Escriche,Valerie Engelmayer,Ya-Wei Eileen Lin,Stefanie Jegelka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了普通Transformer在点云数据集中通过有限数据增强学习各类对称性的能力，发现对称性学习难度呈递增顺序，并揭示了诱导不变性的可解释机制，且该机制可扩展用于学习等变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管用有限数据增强训练Transformer在几何机器学习中日益流行且取得经验性成功，但Transformer架构、对不同对称性的不变性与增强预算三者之间的相互作用仍未被充分探索。

Method: 针对点云数据集，用有限数据增强训练vanilla Transformer，考察其对不同对称群的学习能力；对基础保角子群进一步分析外推行为，并对训练模型进行结构分析以识别可解释的不变性机制；最后将分析扩展到等变函数。

Result: 识别出可学习性递增的对称群顺序：(i)非保角对称、(ii)保角对称、(iii)基础保角子群（如平移、旋转、缩放）；对基础保角子群发现了诱导不变性的可解释机制，并证明这些机制可为学习等变性提供关键构建模块。

Conclusion: 普通Transformer可通过有限数据增强学习多种对称性，且学习难度随对称群类型呈系统性递增；所识别的近似不变性机制不仅能解释不变性，还能作为学习等变性的基础构件，为几何机器学习中数据增强与架构设计提供理论洞见。

Abstract: Training Transformer-based architectures with finite data augmentation has become an increasingly popular approach in geometric machine learning. Despite its empirical success, the interplay between the Transformer architecture, invariance to different symmetries, and augmentation budgets remains underexplored. In this paper, we study the ability of a vanilla Transformer to learn various symmetries through finite data augmentation for point cloud datasets. We identify an ordering of increasing learnability across the following symmetry groups: (i) non-angle-preserving symmetries, (ii) angle-preserving symmetries, and (iii) base angle-preserving subgroups, such as translation, rotation, and scale. For the base angle-preserving groups, we further investigate the Transformer's extrapolation behavior and conduct a structural analysis of the trained models, allowing us to identify interpretable mechanisms that induce invariance. Finally, we extend our analysis to equivariant functions and show that the detected mechanisms for approximate invariance can also provide a key building block for learned equivariance. Our project page is available at https://transformers-learn-symmetries.github.io/

</details>


### [423] [RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10310)
*Fanqing Meng,Lingxiao Du,Haocheng Lu,Qiguang Chen,Ziqi Zhao,Zijian Wu,Jiayuan Zhuo,Mengkang Hu,Michael Qizhe Shieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于 EaaS 的智能体原生研究环境 RSIGym，支持 Data/Harness/Joint 三类递归自我改进轨道，并用 RSI-Index 度量性能差距弥合程度；六个前沿模型独立 Joint 运行中 Opus 5 取得最高 0.4809。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进需将已被接受的改动带入后续改进周期，而研究智能体提出的改动又依赖大量研究基础设施。现有设定要么让智能体重复搭建常规基础设施，要么把探索限制在单个组件上，难以在同一环境中联合优化数据、训练配置与执行框架。

Method: 提出 RSIGym——以"一切皆服务"（EaaS）为基础的智能体原生研究环境，将训练、推理、rollout、评估与沙箱执行封装为可复用服务，并配以共享预算与权限控制，支持 Data、Harness、Joint 三条改进轨道；定义 RSI-Index 为在软件工程、终端交互、数学、科学推理与技能型任务五个基准上弥合剩余性能差距的平均比例。

Result: 在独立 Joint 运行中比较六个前沿研究模型，Opus 5 在每基准运行 500 美元平台服务预算下取得最高 RSI-Index 0.4809；其选出的系统在五个基准上均有提升，SWE-bench Verified 从 17.67% 升至 50.33%，AIME 从 31.67% 升至 97.78%。附加实验考察了 DSH-harness 精炼、预算变化与受限网络访问，轨迹记录揭示智能体如何诊断失败并筛选候选方案。

Conclusion: RSIGym 使智能体能在统一环境中同时研究单项干预并联合优化数据、训练设置与执行框架；开源完整代码库与结果以支持可复现性和后续研究。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires carrying accepted changes into later improvement cycles, while studying agent-proposed changes also requires substantial research infrastructure. Existing settings often leave agents to rebuild routine infrastructure or restrict exploration to individual components. We introduce RSIGym, an agent-native research environment based on Everything as a Service (EaaS). RSIGym exposes training, inference, rollout, evaluation, and sandbox execution through reusable services, with shared budget and permission controls supporting Data, Harness, and Joint improvement tracks. This design enables agents to investigate individual interventions and jointly optimize data, training settings, and execution harnesses within the same environment. We define RSI-Index as the mean fraction of the remaining performance gap closed across five benchmarks covering software engineering, terminal interaction, mathematics, scientific reasoning, and skill-based tasks. Comparing six frontier research models in independent Joint runs, Opus 5 achieves the highest RSI-Index of 0.4809 under a $500 platform-service budget per benchmark run. Its selected systems improve all five benchmarks, raising SWE-bench Verified from 17.67% to 50.33% and AIME from 31.67% to 97.78%. Additional experiments examine DSH-harness refinement, budget variation, and restricted network access, while recorded trajectories reveal how agents diagnose failures and select candidates. We open-source the full RSIGym codebase and results to support reproducibility and further research.

</details>


### [424] [Fault-tolerant foundation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10311)
*Trevor McCourt,Ila R. Fiete,Isaac L. Chuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大语言模型可被训练以容忍不可靠硬件，且随规模增大其容错能力增强；作者推测经适当训练的LLM可能具备形式化容错能力，为低能耗故障硬件上运行AI推理提供节能路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴计算机硬件常以牺牲可靠性换取能效，因此需要探究LLM能否容忍这种不可靠性，以在保证性能的同时实现显著节能。

Method: 在模拟的故障数字硬件上进行40,000 GPU小时训练，并据此推导修正的神经缩放律（modified neural scaling laws）来量化容错趋势。

Result: LLM不仅可被训练容忍硬件不可靠性，且其错误鲁棒性随模型规模增大而提升而非下降；修正的缩放律表明模型学会在"良好"纠错码内计算，其相对开销不随模型规模增大而无限增长。

Conclusion: 推断经适当训练的LLM可能具备形式化容错性；若成立，在低能耗、易故障硬件上运行AI推理有望相较现状实现大幅节能。

Abstract: Emerging computer hardware often trades reliability for energy efficiency; here we show that large-language models (LLMs) can be trained to tolerate this unreliability, and that rather than degrading, their error resilience actually increases as they grow. Modified neural scaling laws inferred from 40,000 GPU-hours of training runs on simulated faulty digital hardware quantify this trend and suggest that models learn to compute within "good" error-correcting codes, whose relative overhead remains finite no matter how large the model gets. This finding leads us to conjecture that appropriately trained LLMs may be formally fault-tolerant; if true, running AI inference on low energy, faulty hardware may be a path to substantial energy savings over the status quo.

</details>


### [425] [PoreML: A Data-Driven Framework for Learning Multiphase Flow in Porous Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10314)
*Chunyang Wang,Mingrui Zhang,Yuyan Zhang,Linqi Zhu,Xin Ju,Edo Sicco Boek,Martin J. Blunt,Gege Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PoreML：面向多孔介质多相流的开源框架，统一数据生成、模型训练与评估，含GPU原生LBM求解器、3.3 TB数据集（560次模拟、158,546时间步、四类场景）及统一学习与评估协议，并评测五种模型、设置跨尺度与合成到微CT迁移两项挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多孔微结构中多相流对CO2封存、燃料电池、倒装芯片封装等至关重要，但润湿性与复杂孔隙几何导致界面非线性演化，预测困难。机器学习虽有潜力，却受限于时间分辨3D数据稀缺以及缺乏统一的训练与评估工作流。

Method: 提出开源框架PoreML，含三部分：(a) 现代GPU原生格子玻尔兹曼求解器，经解析解与已发表实验验证，支持可复现数据生成；(b) 3.3 TB数据集，含560次模拟运行、158,546个存储时间步，覆盖四类应用驱动场景，轨迹涵盖合成结构与真实材料微CT扫描几何，具备多样润湿条件与黏度比；(c) 统一学习框架，评估单步预测与自回归滚动展开，采用领域专用评估协议衡量预测精度与物理一致性。在协议下评测五种不同架构模型，并设两项互补挑战：向更大域迁移、从合成结构向微CT结构迁移。

Result: 构建并公开了PoreML框架及其数据、求解器与评估协议；在单步与自回归任务上对五种模型给出统一基准结果，并通过跨尺度及合成到微CT迁移两项挑战检验泛化能力。

Conclusion: PoreML为多孔介质多相流的机器学习研究提供共享基础，旨在赋能社区开发可靠预测模型并推动领域发展。

Abstract: Multiphase flow in porous microstructures is central to CO$_2$ storage, fuel-cell operation, and flip-chip packaging. Predicting these flows remains challenging because wettability and complex pore geometry govern the nonlinear evolution of fluid interfaces. Machine learning holds substantial promise for advancing the field, but progress is constrained by scarce time-resolved 3D datasets and a lack of a unified workflow for training and evaluating models. To fill this critical gap, we introduce PoreML, an open-source framework unifying data generation, model training, and evaluation grounded in pore-scale physics. The framework comprises three core components. (a) A modern GPU-native lattice Boltzmann solver, validated against analytical solutions and published experiments, enables reproducible data generation. (b) A 3.3 TB dataset contains 560 simulation runs and 158,546 stored time steps across four application-driven scenarios. These trajectories span synthetic structures and geometries derived from micro-CT scans of real materials, covering diverse wetting conditions and viscosity ratios. (c) A unified learning framework evaluates one-step prediction and autoregressive rollouts. Its domain-specific evaluation protocols assess predictive accuracy and physical consistency. We evaluate five models of diverse architecture under these protocols. Two complementary challenges assess transfer to larger domains and from synthetic to micro-CT-derived structures. PoreML provides a shared foundation for machine-learning research on multiphase flow in porous media, with the aim of empowering the community to develop reliable predictive models and advance the field.

</details>


### [426] [Thinking in Depth: Retrospective Inference for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10317)
*Hao-Run Cai,Si-Yang Liu,Zi-Jian Cheng,Kun-Yang Yu,Jin-Hao Sheng,Guo Yu,Chonghan Liu,Zhi Zhou,Jun-Peng Jiang,Lan-Zhe Guo,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Retro，一种基于"回溯推理"的表格基础模型，通过跨层重新访问并重组中间表示，缓解预测细化集中在深层的现象，在多个基准上进入前三并位于 Pareto 前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFMs）多采用堆叠 Transformer 层进行上下文预测，反复变换样本的表示与比较方式。通过追踪单个查询发现，预测细化在各层之间高度不均衡，通常集中在靠后的层，说明中间表示未被充分利用。这一现象促使作者重新思考中间表示在网络中的构建与复用方式。

Method: 作者提出 Retro，将推理范式改为"回溯推理"（retrospective inference），使网络的后期阶段能够显式地重新访问并重组早期产生的中间信息。该过程由两个互补操作构成：（1）"重新访问哪些中间信息"，由 Attention Residuals 实现，自适应地重新加权来自不同深度的贡献；（2）"如何为每个查询塑造得到的上下文更新"，由 query-conditioned Gated Attention 实现，在表示维度上对注意力输出进行逐元素调制。

Result: 分析表明，Retro 将预测细化提前，并在深度上更广泛地分布，不同阶段修订不同子集的查询，呈现出类似"多视角细化"的模式。在 TabArena、TALENT 和 RelArena 三个基准上，Retro 均位列前三，并处于 Pareto 前沿。

Conclusion: 直接复用中间表示是一种更充分利用 TFM 深度信息的实用方法。Retro 通过回溯式重新访问与重组中间信息，改善了深层细化的不均衡问题，并在多个基准上取得具竞争力的性能。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained across diverse tabular tasks and make predictions on a new table at inference time using its labeled examples as context. Most recent TFMs perform such in-context prediction with stacked Transformer layers, repeatedly transforming how examples are represented and compared. By tracing individual queries through several strong TFMs, we find that predictive refinement is highly uneven across depth and is often concentrated in later layers. This uneven refinement motivates us to reconsider how intermediate representations are constructed and reused throughout the network. We introduce Retro, a tabular foundation model based on retrospective inference, where later stages can explicitly revisit and recombine intermediate information produced earlier in the network. Retro organizes this process around two complementary operations: which intermediate information to revisit, and how the resulting contextual update should be shaped for each query. Attention Residuals address the former by adaptively reweighting contributions from different depths, while query-conditioned Gated Attention addresses the latter by modulating the attention output element-wise across representation dimensions. Our analysis shows that Retro shifts predictive refinement earlier and more broadly across depth, with different stages revising different subsets of queries in a pattern suggestive of multi-view refinement. Across TabArena, TALENT, and RelArena, Retro ranks among the top three and lies on the Pareto frontier. These results indicate that directly reusing intermediate representations provides a practical way to better exploit depth in TFMs.

</details>


### [427] [HAN-Mamba: Hierarchical Selective State Space Networks for Multi-Scale Financial Volatility Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10323)
*Mihai Bogdan Deaconu,Ioan Daniel Pop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HAN-Mamba用选择性状态空间(Mamba)编码器替换HAN-T的二次注意力编码器，仅在三token融合器中保留注意力，在Optiver已实现波动率预测基准上以更少参数取得更优RMSPE，并支持更长高频上下文与常数时间流式推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短期已实现波动率预测需整合时间分辨率不兼容的多源市场信息（秒级订单簿动态到周级机制漂移）。已有的分层架构HAN-T依赖二次复杂度注意力编码器，参数多、推理代价高，且高频上下文长度受限、难以支持流式更新。

Method: 提出HAN-Mamba混合架构：将HAN-T中短、中、长三个尺度的Transformer注意力编码器替换为选择性状态空间（Mamba）编码器，通过输入依赖门控的循环状态刻画波动率的两个结构特性——持续性但衰减的记忆与突变式机制转换；仅在跨尺度融合器中保留注意力，因其输入仅为三token集合而非长序列。评估采用时间感知五折交叉验证，数据集为Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction基准。

Result: HAN-Mamba平均RMSPE为0.1942，优于HAN-T的0.1965，且参数量减少33%。线性时间编码器使高频上下文从60个bucket扩展至240个bucket，误差进一步降至0.1927，而注意力变体在该长度已饱和。推理时支持常数时间流式更新。消融实验表明性能提升源于编码器替换，分层先验可跨序列模型族迁移，置换不变注意力融合器仍是跨尺度整合的正确机制。

Conclusion: 以Mamba替换注意力编码器、仅在跨尺度融合阶段保留注意力的混合设计，可在更低参数量下提升短期已实现波动率预测精度，并解锁更长高频上下文与常数时间流式推理；分层先验具有跨模型族的通用性，跨尺度融合仍宜采用置换不变注意力机制。

Abstract: Short-horizon realized volatility forecasting requires the integration of market information that evolves at incompatible temporal resolutions, from second-level order book dynamics to weekly regime drift. Our conference work introduced HAN-T, a hierarchical architecture in which scale-specific Transformer encoders process short, mid, and long-horizon streams and a learned attention fuser weighs their contributions. This article replaces the quadratic attention encoders with selective state space (Mamba) encoders while retaining attention only in the fuser, where the input is a three-token set rather than a long sequence. The resulting hybrid, HAN-Mamba, summarizes each stream through a recurrent state whose input-dependent gating matches two structural properties of volatility: persistent but decaying memory and abrupt regime shifts. On the Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction benchmark under time-aware five-fold cross-validation, HAN-Mamba improves mean RMSPE over HAN-T (0.1942 vs. 0.1965) with 33% fewer parameters. Its linear-time encoders further allow the high-frequency context to be extended from 60 to 240 buckets, reducing error to 0.1927 where the attention variant saturates, and support constant-time streaming updates at inference. Ablations attribute the gains to the encoder swap, confirm that the hierarchical prior transfers across sequence-model families, and show that the permutation-invariant attention fuser remains the correct mechanism for cross-scale integration.

</details>


### [428] [Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Multichain MDPs: A Hierarchical Decomposition Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10326)
*Huizhen Yu,Isaiah Heidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个无需归约到折扣问题的、几乎无模型的平均奖励强化学习算法族，用于一般多链MDP，基于Bather分解将状态空间分层为通信子系统与瞬态状态，包含基础算法及两个改进版本，均具几乎必然收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均奖励多链MDP中，最优增益可能依赖初始状态，且不同策略下递归结构各异，给强化学习带来挑战。现有方法多依赖模型知识或将问题归约为折扣问题，缺乏直接针对一般多链结构的无模型算法。

Method: 提出基于异步值迭代的强化学习算法，仅需MDP转移图信息，利用Bather分解将状态空间分层划分为通信子系统与瞬态状态，把全局决策问题重构为结构化子问题。在此基础上发展两个算法：一个近似求解多链平均最优方程以获得近增益最优策略；另一个通过逼近最优偏差函数并借助基础算法求解诱导的平均奖励多链MDP，实现近偏差最优。

Result: 基础算法有限时间内收敛到最优增益并产生增益最优策略。三个算法均具几乎必然收敛保证。实验比较了各自权衡，后两个算法相对基础算法持续改善瞬态性能。这是已知首个针对一般多链MDP、无需归约为折扣问题的几乎无模型平均奖励强化学习算法。

Conclusion: 该工作为一般多链平均奖励MDP提供了直接的无模型求解框架，借助Bather分解实现结构化学习，兼顾增益最优与偏差最优，并验证了瞬态性能的改进。

Abstract: We study learning optimal policies in average-reward multichain Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the optimal gain may depend on the initial state and recurrence structures vary across policies, creating challenges for reinforcement learning (RL) methods. We propose an asynchronous value-iteration-based RL algorithm that requires no model knowledge beyond the MDP's transition graph and leverages Bather's decomposition to hierarchically partition the state space into communicating subsystems and transient states. This decomposition induces a recasting of the global decision problem into structured subproblems, which our algorithm exploits. We show that the algorithm converges to the optimal gain and produces gain-optimal policies after finite time. Building on this base algorithm, we develop two further algorithms: one approximately solves the multichain average optimality equations to obtain near gain-optimal policies, and another targets near bias-optimality by approximating the optimal bias function and solving an induced average-reward multichain MDP using the base algorithm. We provide almost-sure convergence guarantees for all three algorithms and empirically compare their tradeoffs, showing that the latter two also consistently improve transient performance relative to the base algorithm. To our knowledge, these are the first essentially model-free average-reward RL algorithms for general multichain MDPs without reductions to discounted problems.

</details>


### [429] [AutoAdapt: Automatic Domain Discovery Enables Low-Cost Extensibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10349)
*Josh McGiff,Salma Mekaoui,Robert Shanahan,Nikola S. Nikolov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoAdapt：通过无参数路由与并行单适配器训练实现模块化领域特化，无需全模型重训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令微调模型部署环境中的领域异质且持续演化，新增领域或数据通常需昂贵重训，且易产生领域间干扰。

Method: 模块化框架AutoAdapt：自动发现潜在领域；在各领域上独立并行训练per-domain LoRA适配器；采用无参数路由（parameter-free routing），不修改其他适配器。

Result: 在14个领域基准及GPT-4o成对评判上，AutoAdapt达到与全部领域联合训练的LoRA适配器相当的性能；并发现不同独立发现方法间存在特化效应收敛的证据。

Conclusion: 按领域分别训练适配器从构造上避免领域干扰，实现模块化、免分类法的领域特化，且无总体性能损失、无需全模型重训。

Abstract: Instruction-tuned models are deployed into environments where domains are heterogeneous and evolve, yet adding new domains or data typically requires costly retraining. We present AutoAdapt, a modular framework that incorporates new domains and data via targeted single-adapter training without modifying other adapters. The framework automatically discovers latent domains, uses them to train per-domain Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters independently in parallel and performs parameter-free routing. Across 14 domain-specific benchmarks and GPT-4o pairwise judgements, AutoAdapt achieves parity with a LoRA adapter trained on all domains without requiring full-model retraining. We also find evidence of specialisation effect convergence across independent discovery methods. Overall, training each adapter on its own domain prevents domain interference by construction, thus enabling modular, taxonomy-free domain specialisation without aggregate performance loss or full model retraining.

</details>


### [430] [ORDERS: An Empirical Study of Norm-Rank Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10361)
*Koffka Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了ORDERS个性化联邦学习配置，发现其相对基线的优势主要来自本地训练与评估设置，而非服务器加权规则的额外优化效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化联邦学习常将共享表示与客户端专属预测器结合，但服务器加权规则的真实贡献容易被本地训练和评估选择的差异所遮蔽，需要严格控制变量来厘清。

Method: 在固定数据划分下进行完整评估，共80次最终运行（8种配置×2个数据集×5个随机种子）。ORDERS由共享骨干网络、私有残差适配器与分类器、按更新范数降序分配几何权重、特征对齐和私有参数扰动构成；服务器对同一广播模型所得更新做加权求和，不进行顺序累加式额外优化。

Result: 双类客户端CIFAR-10上，ORDERS原生平均客户端准确率为80.51±0.79%，FedPer-R1为79.02±1.42%，匹配的均匀权重对照为80.27±0.73%；经通用本地微调后与FedPer-R1差距缩小至0.32个百分点。Sent140上ORDERS为74.71±0.49%，仅比事后客户端训练多数类诊断高0.69个百分点。消融实验对范数排序与对齐仅提供有限且依赖端点的证据，扰动无明确收益。参数负载节省分别为5.47%和0.78%。

Conclusion: ORDERS的性能提升在很大程度上可由本地训练和评估设置解释，范数加权、特征对齐与扰动带来的独立增益有限，参数负载节省亦很小，因此服务器加权规则的贡献需谨慎解读。

Abstract: Personalized federated learning combines shared representations with client-specific predictors, but the contribution of a server weighting rule can be obscured by local training and evaluation choices. We study ORDERS, a configuration that combines a shared backbone, a private residual adapter and classifier, geometric weights assigned by descending update norm, feature alignment, and private-parameter perturbations. The server computes a weighted sum of updates obtained from the same broadcast model; it does not obtain an additional optimization effect from sequential addition. A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.

</details>


### [431] [Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10366)
*Hanru Bai,Yuanchao Xu,Fengyi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出观测校正Koopman框架加速冻结扩散模型，用廉价浅层特征观测校正深层特征预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯基于历史特征的缓存预测无法纳入当前去噪状态的变化，需要探索能否用低成本、新计算的浅层特征作为观测来校正预测。

Method: 使用标定轨迹识别有限维、时变的Koopman算子，联合刻画浅层与深层网络特征的增量；加速采样时用算子预测昂贵深层特征演化，用观测到的浅层特征新息校正预测状态，周期性全量评估刷新观测器，生成模型参数保持不变。

Result: 每数据集三次万张图像运行，相同四步部分步调度下，配对Inception特征MSE较通道仿射预测在CIFAR-10降低19.9%、十类ImageNet子集降低11.9%；匹配消融显示观测校正额外贡献4.54%和4.67%的降幅；实测相对DDIM-50加速1.89倍与1.85倍。

Conclusion: 观测校正的Koopman框架可在不重训去噪器的前提下提升参考采样器保真度，并实现有效加速。

Abstract: Feature caching accelerates diffusion sampling by replacing expensive network evaluations with predictions from previously computed activations. However, forecasts based only on past features cannot directly incorporate changes in the current denoising state. We investigate whether inexpensive, freshly computed features can serve as observations for correcting these predictions. We introduce an observation-corrected Koopman framework for accelerating frozen diffusion models. Using calibration trajectories, we identify finite-dimensional, time-dependent Koopman approximations that jointly describe the increments of shallow and deep network features. During accelerated sampling, these operators predict the evolution of expensive deep features, while innovations in the observed shallow features correct the predicted state. Periodic full evaluations refresh the observer, and all generative-model parameters remain unchanged. This formulation enables controlled comparisons of temporal prediction and observation correction. Across three 10,000-image runs per dataset, our method reduces paired Inception-feature MSE by $19.9\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $11.9\%$ on a ten-class ImageNet subset relative to channelwise affine prediction under the same four-partial-step schedule. Matched ablations attribute additional reductions of $4.54\%$ and $4.67\%$ to observation correction. The observer achieves $1.89\times$ and $1.85\times$ measured speedups over DDIM-50, supporting improved reference-sampler fidelity without retraining the denoiser.

</details>


### [432] [Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10368)
*Yibei Guo,Rui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过32个层跳过/重复程序、2个模型、4413道多选题，比较"自适应选择增益"与"同位置输入盲扰动"的增益，发现在共享选项顺序下控制组反而留出更大提升空间，说明选择增益不能证明所选层计算本身带来特定收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层程序的自适应计算常用oracle评估（借助已知答案）估计潜在增益，但"存在选择增益"并不能解释被选程序为何有效；需要区分"选择带来的增益"与"所选层计算本身特异的收益"。

Method: 在Qwen3-4B-Base与Llama-3.1-8B上，对4413道多选题运行32个层跳过与重复程序；将被选程序相对固定动作的增益，与同位置、输入盲（input-blind）扰动及固定字母偏移等对照的增益比较；采用多个随机方向抽样、共享/旋转选项顺序、KL校准的输入依赖对照，并在另一提示下重新评估选择，另加生成式答案的改写测试。

Result: 共享选项顺序下，控制组在Qwen3-4B-Base上留出10.2–11.8个百分点、Llama-3.1-8B上15.6–19.4个百分点的headroom，超过真实程序的9.0与10.1，且在每个模型的三个随机方向抽样中均如此；控制组仅在答案改变率上匹配。排序依赖菜单：Llama仅重复菜单的事后比较中真实程序每次抽样领先。较小规模KL校准对照（含输入依赖控制）在点估计上支持真实程序，但校正检验不确定。固定字母偏移产生同量级headroom；旋转选项显著降低两族headroom，仍保留1.4–2.3与3.7–4.5个百分点的正向真实减控制差，其幅度与统计支持依赖后续调整与参考基准。补充生成式答案测试显示，搜索选出的程序在改写后相对"为其他问题选出的程序"保持26.0个百分点优势，但缺少安慰剂对照。

Conclusion: 在共享选项顺序下，跨提示仍可存在可观headroom，却不足以证明所选层计算具有特异收益；无论相对哪类对照的排序，都无法据此识别这种收益。

Abstract: Adaptive computation aims to improve language-model inference by tailoring execution to each input. For layer programs, oracle evaluations use known answers to estimate the potential gain from this flexibility, before a practical selector is available. However, a gain from selection does not by itself explain why the chosen programs help. This study examines this distinction using 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on two models and 4,413 multiple-choice items. The analysis compares their gains over a fixed action selected without the evaluation prompt with those of input-blind perturbations at the same sites, re-evaluating selections on another prompt. With shared option order, the controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of headroom on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, exceeding the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1 in all three random-direction draws per model. They match answer-change rate only, and the ordering depends on the menu: in post hoc comparisons, real programs lead on Llama's repeat-only menu in every draw. A smaller KL-calibrated comparison, including an input-dependent control, favours real programs in point estimate, with inconclusive corrected tests. Fixed letter offsets produce headroom of similar scale. Rotating options sharply reduces both families' headroom, while leaving positive real-minus-control differences of 1.4-2.3 and 3.7-4.5 points; their magnitudes and statistical support depend on further adjustments and the reference. A supplementary generated-answer test finds that search-selected programs keep a 26.0-point advantage over programs selected for other problems after rewording, without a placebo comparison. These results show that substantial headroom can persist across prompts with shared option order without establishing a benefit specific to the selected layer computation; neither ordering against these controls identifies that benefit.

</details>


### [433] [Continual Learning without Continual Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10379)
*Nikita Narayanan,Ritham Majumdarr,Sonali Parbhoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Concept PFN，将持续学习从"持续训练"转变为"持续推理"：模型经元训练后冻结参数，仅通过扩展上下文证据集来适应新类别/新领域，在隐概念空间做上下文贝叶斯推断，从而减少遗忘，并统一处理类别增量与领域增量学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法多依赖持续优化，通过正则化、回放或参数扩展来防止新更新覆盖旧知识，但这类方法仍涉及参数更新，容易产生遗忘，且往往需要任务标识、难以同时兼顾领域增量与类别增量。作者希望避免任何梯度更新，从根源上缓解遗忘问题。

Method: 提出基于PFN的Latent Concept PFN：元训练后冻结，适应仅靠扩展上下文证据集（新增样本加入记忆），在捕捉跨领域、跨类别语义结构的隐概念空间上进行上下文贝叶斯推断；适应体现为隐概念后验信念的更新而非梯度更新，参数不变。概念标注仅在元训练阶段使用，作为隐空间的软锚点而非固定瓶颈；通过概念标签与原始输入证据结合，可处理噪声、歧义或不完整标注，发现预定义概念集之外的区分性特征。同一方法在无任务标识下统一处理领域增量与类别增量。

Result: 在类别增量与领域增量学习数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了有竞争力的持续学习性能，同时学习到可解释的隐概念。

Conclusion: 将持续学习重构为持续推理是可行且有效的：冻结参数、仅扩展上下文证据即可实现对新领域与新类别的适应，减少遗忘，并在无任务标识条件下统一处理两类增量场景，兼具竞争性性能与概念可解释性。

Abstract: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.

</details>


### [434] [ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10381)
*Heejun Kim,Junyoung Lee,SangLyul Cho,Dongsu Han,Insu Han,Sehoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ResidualQuant，利用循环 Transformer 中各循环 KV 高度相似的特点，以末次循环 KV 为参考、对其余循环做低精度残差量化，结合最小二乘缩放、旋转与逐循环混合精度，实现至 INT2 的准确量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复复用共享块提升参数效率，但 KV cache 随循环数线性增长，成为限制批大小与吞吐的内存瓶颈；现有 KV 量化方法在激进低精度下精度损失严重。

Method: 观察到跨循环 KV 状态高度相似，ResidualQuant 以最后一次循环的 KV 作为参考，用低精度残差表示其余循环，并引入最小二乘缩放、对残差施加旋转以及逐循环混合精度。

Result: 在多个循环 Transformer 模型及数学推理、代码生成基准上，精度-内存权衡优于先进旋转式 KV 量化；混合精度下精度接近 BF16，理论 KV 存储降低 80.7%，相同内存预算下精度最高提升 13.0%；RTX 5090 上固定批解码吞吐最高提升 2.73x，显存占用降低支持最高 2x 更大批大小，峰值吞吐最高提升 4.15x。

Conclusion: 利用循环结构的 KV 冗余进行残差量化，可在极低精度下保持精度并显著降低存储与访存开销，从而同时提升批大小与推理吞吐。

Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks over multiple recurrent loops, increasing computational depth without increasing the parameter count. However, KV cache memory still scales with the number of loops, becoming a key memory bottleneck that limits batch size and inference throughput. KV cache quantization can alleviate this bottleneck, but existing methods often suffer substantial accuracy degradation at aggressive low-precision regimes. We observe that looped Transformers offer a unique opportunity: KV states across loops are highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose ResidualQuant, which uses the final-loop KV states as a reference and represents the remaining loops with low-precision residuals. Our method further combines least-square scaling and rotations applied to the residuals, as well as loop-wise mixed precision, to enable accurate quantization down to INT2 while retaining efficient reconstruction. Across multiple looped Transformer models and mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, ResidualQuant consistently improves the accuracy-memory tradeoff over state-of-the-art rotation-based KV quantization. In particular, our method retains accuracy close to BF16 under mixed-precision settings while reducing theoretical KV storage by 80.7%, achieving up to 13.0% higher accuracy than the rotation-based baseline at the same memory budget. On an RTX 5090, the reduced KV memory traffic improves fixed-batch decode throughput by up to 2.73x, while the smaller memory footprint enables up to 2x larger batches, improving peak throughput by up to 4.15x.

</details>


### [435] [Boosting and the Expressive Power of Simple Weak Learners via the $γ$-VC Dimension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10383)
*Arthur da Cunha,Kasper Green Larsen,Liang-Yu Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过γ-VC维度刻画Boosting中弱到强学习的样本复杂度，改进了经典VC维度与γ-VC维度的一般关系，并对决策树桩与轴平行矩形两类基本概念类给出了更紧的γ-VC维度上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Boosting可将仅比随机猜测略好的弱假设转化为高精度预测器，但所得分类器的表达能力强烈依赖于基类的结构。既有理论尚未充分刻画这种依赖关系，本文借助Alon等人（STOC 2021）提出的γ-VC维度来研究该现象。

Method: 以γ-VC维度为核心工具进行理论分析：证明该参数在γ的常数因子缩放意义下刻画的弱到强学习样本复杂度；进一步细化经典VC维度与γ-VC维度之间的一般关系；并针对决策树桩与ℝ^d中轴平行矩形这两类基本概念类，推导改进的γ-VC维度上界与下界。

Result: 证明了γ-VC维度可在γ的常数因子缩放意义下刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度；给出了经典VC维度与γ-VC维度之间更精确的关系；对决策树桩及ℝ^d中轴平行矩形的γ-VC维度获得了更优的上界与下界。

Conclusion: γ-VC维度是刻画Boosting表达能力的合适参数，能统一刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度并细化与经典VC维度的关系；针对基本概念类的紧界结果进一步揭示了基类结构对Boosting表达能力的影响。

Abstract: Boosting converts weak hypotheses with a small edge over random guessing into highly accurate predictors, but the expressive power of the resulting classifier can depend strongly on the structure of the base class. We study this phenomenon through the $γ$-VC dimension introduced by Alon et al. (STOC 2021). Our first result shows that this parameter characterizes the sample complexity for weak-to-strong learning up to a constant factor scaling in $γ$. We then sharpen the general relationship between the classic VC dimension and the $γ$-VC dimension. Finally, we also give improved upper and lower bounds on the $γ$-VC dimension for the fundamental concept classes of decision stumps and axis-parallel rectangles in $\mathbb{R}^d$.

</details>


### [436] [OrBIT: Structure-Guided Embedding Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10385)
*Yunied Puig,Amit Kumar Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 OrBIT，一种结构引导的嵌入表压缩框架，首次让“编码几何”本身可被学习发现，而非固定在坐标块、低秩子空间或自由码本上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入表是现代语言模型中最大的组成部分之一，现有压缩方法大多预设固定的编码几何（如坐标块、低秩子空间或不受约束的码本）并在其内部做优化，限制了压缩潜力。作者因此追问：编码几何本身能否被自动发现。

Method: OrBIT 从轨形（orbit）动力学中学习可复用的局部几何，并用其约束一小组共享码字；全局重建残差决定固定编码预算的分配位置；冗余重叠图卡（charts）经粘合后使局部误差相互补偿。理论刻画了三件事：紧致图卡几何如何控制失真、全局残差如何引导顺序分配、以及数据几何引导的精化如何改进编解码器。最终轨形机制被编译消除，仅留下紧凑解码器。

Result: 在四个 LLM 嵌入表上，OrBIT 相对 16 位存储在 GPT-2 上实现 37.9× 压缩，在每个 7B 表上超过 23× 压缩，同时在率失真性能上与已有量化和低秩基线相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 结果表明编码几何可以被学习并用于指导嵌入压缩：所学结构决定存储什么、容量分配到何处、以及局部信息如何全局组装，从而实现高压缩比且保持有竞争力的率失真表现。

Abstract: Embedding tables are among the largest components of modern language models. Most compression methods fix a coding geometry such as coordinate blocks, low-rank subspaces, or unrestricted codebooks, and optimize within it. We instead ask whether the coding geometry can itself be discovered. We introduce \emph{OrBIT}, a structure-guided embedding compression framework that learns reusable local geometry from orbit dynamics and uses it to constrain a small set of shared codewords. The global reconstruction residual then decides where the fixed coding budget is spent, while redundant overlapping charts let local errors compensate one another after gluing. Our theory shows how tight-chart geometry controls distortion, how the global residual directs sequential allocation, and how data-geometry-guided refinement improves the codec. The resulting orbit machinery is compiled away, leaving a compact decoder in which the learned structure governs what is stored, where capacity is allocated, and how local information is assembled globally. Across four LLM embedding tables, OrBIT achieves $37.9\times$ compression on GPT-2 and over $23\times$ on each 7B table relative to 16-bit storage, while delivering competitive rate-distortion performance against established quantization and low-rank baselines.

</details>


### [437] [Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10394)
*Richard Cornelius Suwandi,Feng Yin,Kevin Murphy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Kernaut，将核设计视为开放式模型发现，用编码智能体写程序、构造契约保证有效性、质量-多样性存档保留多样高性能核，并用新颖性筛选引导搜索，所发现的核具有可泛化、可解释的归纳偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动核设计面临两难：固定基核与算子的语法虽能保证有效性，却把搜索空间限制在这些构件可表达的结构内；而无限制程序虽突破此限制，却无法保证有效性。压力测试显示，22-58%通过随机输入数值检验的LLM生成核在不同尺度或维度下评测会失败，说明有效性缺口是核心痛点。

Method: Kernaut把核设计当作开放式模型发现：编码智能体将核写成程序；用构造契约（construction contracts）确保每个被接受的核都有效；维护质量-多样性存档，保留行为各异的高性能核；通过新颖性筛选（novelty screening）引导智能体提出功能上新的候选核。

Result: 所发现的核编码了可复用且能泛化到未见任务的归纳偏置。在留出的黑箱优化族上，发现的核优于在同一批情景上元学习的深度核；由十条酶动力学速率定律发现的核，在五个未见机制上误差低于调优的ARD核与深度核基线。这些核是可解释程序，人类研究者可继续改进：人工改进版本进一步将留出预测误差降低5.7%、优化遗憾降低7.8%。

Conclusion: 将核设计开放为程序级模型发现，并以构造契约保障有效性、以质量-多样性存档与新颖性筛选维持探索多样性，可行且有效；所发现的核可泛化、可解释，并能被人类进一步精炼，形成自动化与人类协作结合的设计范式。

Abstract: Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic rate laws achieve lower error than tuned ARD and deep kernel baselines on five unseen mechanisms. The discovered kernels are also interpretable programs that human researchers can refine: a human-refined version of one further reduces the held-out predictive error by 5.7% and optimization regret by 7.8%.

</details>


### [438] [Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10395)
*Amartya Roy,Sayar Karmakar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer能否精确执行因果发现问题中的连续优化算法，显式构造了固定权重的Transformer块以精确复现标准连续因果发现方法的单步更新，并给出更新次数与误差界条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明Transformer能在输入数据上执行算法，但能否对因果发现问题做同样的事尚不清楚。作者希望探究Transformer是否具备精确执行连续因果发现优化过程的能力，并厘清算法执行精度与因果恢复精度之间的区别。

Method: 针对一种反复更新候选因果图并强制无环性的标准连续方法，显式构造一个固定权重Transformer，使其前向传播精确复现该方法的单步更新，从而用重复堆叠的块复现整个优化轨迹。Transformer在更新之间携带当前图与算法乘子。作者进一步分析了保留乘子的必要性，并给出在固定阶段内预先计算达到目标精度所需更新次数以及深度增长时舍入误差有界的条件。

Result: 构造的Transformer块与参考更新在浮点精度上一致；在合成数据和七个已发表基准网络拓扑上的算术重放继承了参考求解器的成功与失败。普通注意力模型在给定训练预算下无法可靠执行该更新，也不能迁移到更大的图上。

Conclusion: 该工作将精确的算法执行与准确的因果恢复区分开来，表明固定权重构造可以精确模拟连续因果发现优化，而梯度训练是否能在该架构类中学习到此类执行器仍是一个开放问题。

Abstract: Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. This separates accurate algorithm execution from accurate causal recovery. In contrast, the ordinary attention models tested under our training budgets do not reliably execute the update or transfer to larger graphs. Whether gradient training can learn an executor in the architecture class of the construction remains open.

</details>


### [439] [Cross-Domain Pretraining for Steady-State Neural CFD Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10398)
*Anthony Zhou,Amir Barati Farimani,Shirley Ho,Rudy Morel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 跨域预训练可显著提升CFD神经代理模型的泛化能力：微调预训练模型在相同样本量下误差降低2-3倍，达到相同误差所需样本量减少8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFD神经代理模型虽能加速仿真，但缺乏对训练集之外几何与工况的泛化能力。当前解决方式是为特定应用重新生成数据集，但需运行昂贵的数值求解器。作者希望探索通过跨几何、边界条件和保真度的预训练来缓解这一问题。

Method: 研究跨不同几何、边界条件和保真度训练的神经代理模型；对比跨域预训练、从零训练以及从领域特定专家模型迁移三种策略；在留出数据集上评估零样本与少样本性能；并分析跨域预训练有效的机理，发现直接池化稳态数据集即可。

Result: 跨域预训练优于从零训练和领域专家迁移。微调预训练跨域模型在相同样本量下误差降低2-3倍，达到相同误差所需样本减少8倍。该收益与架构无关，且随模型规模和预训练数据多样性增加而提升。

Conclusion: 鉴于CFD数据生成成本高昂，通过跨域预训练利用现有数据集将成为未来代理模型拓展新问题与新应用场景的重要策略。

Abstract: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have the potential to greatly enhance engineering innovation through accelerating simulation. However, the primary limitation for neural surrogates is the lack of generalization to geometries and applications beyond the training set, which is significant given the diversity of engineering scenarios. Currently, this is addressed by generating a new dataset for a specific application; however, this requires running costly numerical solvers. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this by studying neural surrogates trained across different geometries, boundary conditions, and fidelities. We find that cross-domain pretraining improves zero- and few-shot performance on held-out datasets relative to both training from scratch and transferring from domain-specific experts. In particular, finetuning a pretrained, cross-domain model can achieve 2-3x lower errors at the same sample size and use 8x fewer samples to achieve the same error, compared to training from scratch. This benefit is architecture agnostic and improves with model size and pretraining dataset diversity. Furthermore, we study how and why cross-domain pretraining works in CFD surrogates, and find that simply pooling steady-state datasets is both sufficient and effective. Given the high cost of generating CFD data, leveraging existing datasets through cross-domain pretraining will likely be a valuable strategy as future surrogates expand to tackle new problems and use cases.

</details>


### [440] [Training Parallel Speculative Draft Models by Directly Minimizing Expected Decoding Rounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10411)
*Yunxiao Zhao,Changxiao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将投机解码建模为马尔可夫奖励过程，提出EDR训练目标及其精确时序差分梯度，可无偏优化全局解码效率，并在九个基准上超越现有训练目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行与半自回归草稿模型能一次前向生成整块token以提升起草效率，但其训练存在难点：某位置的草稿分布依赖解码轮次的起点，而起点又取决于前几轮接受token的数量。现有训练目标多采用块局部代理，忽略跨轮耦合，未直接优化全局解码效率。

Method: 将投机解码形式化为马尔可夫奖励过程，提出期望解码轮数（EDR）目标，用状态占据度对局部拒绝代价加权，且精确等于期望解码轮数；推导精确的时序差分梯度，支持基于目标模型rollout的无偏随机优化；同框架还给出轮数的精确离线评估器，可在共享rollout上配对比较草稿模型而无需实际运行投机解码。

Result: EDR不引入额外辅助超参数；对DSpark和DFly两种最新草稿模型微调后，在数学推理、代码生成和对话共九个基准上，平均接受长度持续提升，优于现有训练目标。

Conclusion: EDR为并行/半自回归草稿模型的训练与评估提供了无超参、无偏且精确的理论框架，可直接优化全局解码效率并改善多任务表现。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a low-cost draft model to propose tokens that the full-size target model verifies in parallel. Parallel and semi-autoregressive (semi- AR) drafters improve drafting efficiency by proposing an entire block in a single forward pass, but training them raises a new difficulty: the draft distribution for a given position depends on where the decoding round starts, and where rounds start depends on how many tokens earlier rounds accepted. Existing training objectives typically rely on block-local surrogates that ignore this cross-round coupling, and therefore do not directly optimize the global decoding efficiency. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for training and evaluating these drafters by representing speculative decoding as a Markov reward process. This formulation yields the Expected Decoding Rounds (EDR) objective, which weights local rejection costs by state occupancies and exactly equals the expected number of decoding rounds. Unlike prior surrogate objectives, EDR introduces no auxiliary hyperparameters. We then derive an exact temporal-difference gradient that supports unbiased stochastic optimization from target-model rollouts. The same framework also yields an exact offline evaluator for round counts, enabling paired drafter comparisons on shared target rollouts without running speculative decoding. Finetuning two state-of-the- art drafters, DSpark and DFly, with EDR consistently improves mean accepted length and outperforms existing training objectives across nine benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and chat.

</details>


### [441] [Which Rollout Taught It That? BehaviorTrace and the Limits of Training-Data Attribution in Online RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10422)
*Amit Nautiyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 BehaviorTrace 评估框架，研究 RL 微调（GRPO）中归因方法能否定位"教会"模型新行为的训练 rollout，并揭示多数归因信号源于混淆因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习让语言模型习得新行为后，能否找出导致该行为的训练 rollout 是归因研究的核心问题；但现有归因方法缺乏可靠的评估手段，无法判断结果是否真实。作者希望在一个行为成因已知的"植入行为"设定下，系统检验归因信号的有效性。

Method: 采用在线 RL 微调（GRPO），植入具有已知成因的行为，并发布 BehaviorTrace 评估工具，整合全梯度 sketching、植入行为装置，以及对梯度幅度、流畅度、提升空间、随机种子与生成采样等混淆因素的控制。评估对象为已有估计器，包括 GAS（重归一化 TracInCP）和 TRAK 风格估计器，不提出新方法。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的三个随机种子上，大量表观归因信号来自混淆因素：仅按梯度大小对训练步排序、不含行为目标的对照方法达到 4.2–4.5 倍随机水平，并在三个种子中的两个上媲美或超过最优目标估计器；在饱和检查点上，模型流畅度对行为标签的预测能力不弱于所有对比的梯度方法。控制流畅度后，逐 rollout 结果随种子和生成采样而变。唯一在三种子均成立的是：触发 token 的梯度与"行为实际发生处"构建的目标对齐。

Conclusion: 作者将发现整理为 RL 归因评估清单，强调需控制梯度幅度、流畅度、提升空间等混淆因素，并指出单次运行不足以定论；唯一稳健的信号来自触发 token 梯度与行为发生位置的对应关系。

Abstract: When reinforcement learning teaches a language model a new behavior, can we find the training rollouts that taught it? And when an attribution method says it can, how do we know the answer is real? We study both questions on online RL fine-tuning with GRPO, using a planted behavior with a known cause. We release BehaviorTrace, an open evaluation harness that combines full-gradient sketching, the planted-behavior setup, and controls for gradient magnitude, fluency, headroom, and variation across seeds and generation draws. Across three seeds on Qwen2.5-1.5B, much of the apparent attribution signal comes from confounds. A control that ranks training steps by gradient size alone, with no behavior target, reaches 4.2 to 4.5 times chance and matches or beats the best targeted estimator on two of three seeds. At saturated checkpoints, model fluency predicts the behavior label at least as well as every gradient method we compared it with. Once fluency is controlled, the per-rollout results change from seed to seed and from one generation draw to the next, so a single run cannot settle the question. One signal does hold on all three seeds. The gradient of the trigger tokens aligns with a target built where the behavior actually occurs. We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating attribution in RL. We test existing estimators, including GAS (renormalized TracInCP) and a TRAK-style estimator, and do not propose a new one.

</details>


### [442] [Seq-Flow: Efficient Probabilistic Forecasting with Self-Rollout Error Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10440)
*Yinan Huang,Shitij Govil,Bo Dai,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Seq-Flow：以条件流模型将上一时刻预测分布传输到更新后的预测分布，结合自rollout训练缓解误差累积，在少步采样下实现高效且长时间稳定的科学预测更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学预测任务需随新观测到来不断更新未来轨迹分布。传统扩散/流模型从高斯噪声采样、步数多；warm-start方法复用早期预测降低成本，但模型未针对"预测更新"本身训练，少步采样下质量受损。

Method: 提出Seq-Flow——条件流模型，其ODE将样本从上一预测分布输运到更新后的分布；因相邻预测差异小，起点信息丰富，故少数流评估即可完成更新。针对递归复用导致的误差累积，采用self-rollout训练：用模型的滑动平均副本生成预测，作为后续训练更新的初始状态（而非像self-forcing那样作为条件上下文）。

Result: 在粒子加速器束流预测任务上，少NFE采样预算下CRPS降低65%；在流体动力学预测任务上与强基线相当。尽管训练最多仅含四次更新的自rollout，Seq-Flow在超过400次连续更新中仍保持准确。

Conclusion: Seq-Flow通过预测分布间的条件流输运与self-rollout训练，实现了少步、高质量且可长期递归的预测更新，代码已开源。

Abstract: Many scientific forecasting tasks require updating a distribution over future trajectories as new observations arrive. Conventional diffusion and flow models generate each forecast from Gaussian noise, often at the cost of many sampling steps. Warm-start methods reuse earlier predictions to reduce this cost, but their models are not trained to perform the forecast update itself, which can compromise quality under few-step sampling. In this work, we introduce Seq-Flow, a conditional flow model whose ODE transports samples from the previous forecast distribution to the updated one. Because successive forecasts often differ only modestly, this transport starts from an informative distribution and can produce accurate updates with few flow evaluations. Recursive reuse also creates a challenge: errors in one forecast become errors in the initial states of subsequent flows. We address this with self-rollout training, in which a moving average copy of the model generates forecasts that initialize later training updates. Unlike self-forcing methods, which reuse generated outputs as conditioning context, Seq-Flow reuses them as the source of the next flow. Experiments On particle-accelerator beam spill forecasting show Seq-Flow reduces CRPS by 65% under a few-NFE sampling budget, while remaining competitive with strong baselines on fluid-dynamics forecasting tasks. Although trained on self-rollouts of at most four updates, Seq-Flow remains accurate over more than 400 consecutive updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/Seq-Flow.

</details>


### [443] [A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10447)
*Randy Ardywibowo,Arnav Dalal,Jiantao Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出JOLT方法：针对强化学习奖励稀疏与特权自蒸馏中教师监督可能失配的问题，推导了教师局部蒸馏更新等于学生奖励梯度正倍数（充要条件），据此设计融合结果奖励与对学生token级KL正则的教师训练代理目标，同一策略联合扮演特权教师与非特权学生进行在线蒸馏，在数学推理、编程、工具使用与终端操作任务上提升训练效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL依赖结果奖励导致监督稀疏，长程难任务成功轨迹稀少且生成代价高。On-Policy Distillation（OPD）可借助更强教师在学生自身生成上提供稠密token级监督；自蒸馏进一步用特权信息对同一策略加条件，充当自身教师，省去独立教师。但仅靠特权条件无法保证蒸馏更新一定改善学生：特权信息可能让教师走学生无法获得的捷径，产生与学生当前行为不匹配的监督，甚至使更高性能的教师反过来损害学生。因此需要刻画何种特权教师才能带来有益更新。

Method: 1）分析特权教师选择对学生更新的影响，推导教师局部蒸馏更新为学生奖励梯度正倍数的充要条件；2）由该条件得出：教师不仅要任务表现好，还应提供契合学生当前能力的指导；3）据此构造实用的教师训练代理目标，将结果奖励与面向学生的token级KL正则结合；4）提出Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching（JOLT）：联合训练单一策略的两种角色——用KL正则目标训练的特权教师，以及用稠密在线策略蒸馏训练的无特权学生。

Result: 在数学推理、编程、工具使用与终端使用等任务上，JOLT提升了训练效率与性能；引入学生奖励后还能获得进一步提升。

Conclusion: 特权自蒸馏的有效性取决于教师监督是否与学生学习能力匹配：只有当教师局部蒸馏更新是学生奖励梯度的正倍数时，蒸馏才朝有利方向更新。JOLT通过KL正则约束特权教师贴近学生、并对学生做在线策略蒸馏，实现了高效且高性能的联合学习与教学，并可兼容学生结果奖励以进一步增强。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) from outcome rewards suffers from sparse supervision, particularly on difficult, long-horizon tasks where successful trajectories are rare and costly to generate. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers an attractive alternative by providing dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher along the student's own generations. Self-distillation methods further remove the need for a separate teacher model by conditioning the same policy on privileged information to serve as its own teacher. However, privileged conditioning alone does not guarantee that the resulting distillation update improves the student. Indeed, privileged information can lead the teacher to solve tasks through shortcuts unavailable to the student, producing supervision poorly matched to the student's current behavior. Consequently, even a higher-performing teacher can provide guidance that degrades student performance. To address this, we analyze how the choice of privileged teacher affects the student's update. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the teacher's local distillation update to be a positive multiple of the student's reward gradient. Our analysis suggests that the teacher should not only perform well on the task, but also provide guidance suited to the student's current capabilities. This characterization motivates a practical teacher-training surrogate that combines outcome rewards with token-level Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the student. Based on this result, we propose Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching (JOLT), which jointly trains a single policy in two roles: a privileged teacher using a KL-regularized objective, and an unprivileged student using dense on-policy distillation. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, JOLT improves training efficiency and performance, with further gains from student rewards.

</details>


### [444] [NeuralBES: A Differentiable, Control-Aware Emulator for Scalable Building Energy Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10459)
*Ting-Yu Dai,Takuya Kurihana,Wing Yee Au,Hon Yung Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuralBES 用共享神经编码器参数化 RC 热模型，将建筑元数据映射为物理有界的电容、电导与设备系数，构成线性递推系数并用对数空间并行扫描求解，配合预测-校正闭环处理恒温器非线性，在单编码器下统一建模异构建筑并兼顾物理有效性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求侧灵活性（负荷预测、转移与削减）依赖可跨数百万异构建筑可信的热模型。现有工具存在硬性权衡：EnergyPlus 等高保真物理仿真准确但串行且需逐建筑标定；纯数据驱动序列模型可扩展却丢弃物理结构，导致预测可信度不足。

Method: 提出 NeuralBES 可微分仿真器：以共享神经编码器参数化 RC 热模型。静态建筑元数据（面积、建造年代、HVAC 类型）映射为物理有界的热容、热导与设备系数，作为标量线性递推的系数，通过对数空间并行扫描求解；预测-校正环处理恒温器-温度非线性，同时保持全时域梯度流。在 ResStock 数据集三个气候区上训练。

Result: 单一训练编码器可覆盖异构建筑原型、年代与气候区；黑箱基线轨迹统计上合理但物理不一致。年度整年 rollout 中，NeuralBES 是唯一同时满足物理有效、且与最强原始误差基线的 MAPE 差距在 4 个百分点内的数据条件模型；参数量比 transformer 与循环基线少约一个数量级；在参数量对齐的物理有效基线中，其 MAPE 不到灰箱 RC 方案的一半。

Conclusion: NeuralBES 通过将物理结构嵌入可学习架构，消除了高保真仿真与数据驱动模型之间的权衡，实现了可扩展、物理有效且高精度的建筑能耗仿真。

Abstract: Demand-side flexibility i.e. forecasting, shifting, and curtailing residential energy loads, depends on thermal models trusted across millions of heterogeneous buildings. Existing tools force a hard tradeoff: high-fidelity physics simulators such as EnergyPlus are accurate but sequential and require per-building calibration, while purely data-driven sequence models scale but abandon the physical structure that makes their predictions trustworthy.
  We introduce NeuralBES (Building Energy Simulation), a differentiable emulator that resolves this tradeoff by parameterizing a resistance--capacitance (RC) based thermal model with a shared neural encoder: static building metadata such as floor area, vintage, and HVAC type is mapped to physically bounded capacitances, conductances, and equipment coefficients, which become the coefficients of a scalar linear recurrence solved via a log-space parallel scan, and a predictor--corrector loop closes the thermostat--temperature nonlinearity while preserving full-horizon gradient flow. Trained on the ResStock dataset across three climate zones, NeuralBES handles heterogeneous building archetypes, vintages, and climate zones within a single trained encoder, while black-box baselines produce statistically plausible but physically inconsistent trajectories. On the annual full-year rollout, NeuralBES is the only data-conditioned model that is simultaneously physics-valid and accurate to within 4 MAPE points of the strongest raw-error baseline, while operating at roughly an order of magnitude fewer parameters than the transformer and recurrent baselines; among physics-valid baselines at parameter parity it more than halves the MAPE of the grey-box RC alternative.

</details>


### [445] [Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10460)
*Hejian Sang,Zhengze Zhou,Shayan Mohajer Hamidi,Xiaomin Li,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Δ-MOPD，将多教师蒸馏中的监督目标从教师的端点策略改为“教师减基座”的对数几率偏移量，并重新锚定在学生的冻结初始化上；实验表明该偏移目标在“同状态组合多教师信号”的场景下优于端点监督，而在每次更新仅涉及单个教师的交错路由场景下两者相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）在共同域组合和路由域蒸馏两种设置下，通常迁移各教师的端点策略；但端点策略混合了后训练带来的变化与从教师基座继承的偏好，其中继承的基座拉扯可能超过后训练偏移，从而阻碍有效迁移。作者希望分离并去除这种继承成分，明确“目标构造”这一独立设计维度。

Method: 提出 Δ-MOPD：迁移每个教师的“教师减基座”对数几率偏移（teacher-minus-base logit shift），并将该偏移重新锚定到学生的冻结初始化上。在保持教师选择不变的前提下，与端点监督在两种设置（共同域组合、路由域蒸馏）下进行对比；并进行机制分析，考察继承基座拉扯、教师项范数比与目标—学生 KL。

Result: 去除继承基座拉扯可降低教师项范数比与目标—学生 KL。三个教师组合时，Δ-MOPD 比端点组合高出 4.11 Math 与 1.95 五项基准分；两个教师时与端点精度相当。分阶段路由下，Δ-MOPD 在两种阶段顺序下均取得更高平均性能，并将观测到的顺序差距从 10.50 分降至 6.42 分。交错路由（每次更新仅涉及一个教师）下两种目标表现相当。

Conclusion: 偏移目标在教师信号于同一状态被组合时尤为有效，分阶段结果为其收益可延伸至跨训练阶段累积的信号提供了支持性证据。目标构造因此是 MOPD 中与教师选择互补的独立设计轴。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $Δ$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL.
  Across our experiments, the results suggest that shift targets are particularly useful when teacher signals are combined at a state. With three composed teachers, $Δ$-MOPD exceeds endpoint composition by $4.11$ Math and $1.95$ five-benchmark points; with two, it matches endpoint accuracy. Under phased routing, it achieves higher mean performance in both phase orders and reduces the observed order gap from $10.50$ to $6.42$ points. Under interleaved routing, where each update involves one teacher, the two targets perform comparably. The phased results provide supporting evidence that the benefit may extend to signals accumulated across training phases. Target construction is thus an independent design axis in MOPD, complementary to teacher selection.

</details>


### [446] [Two-Level Softmax Sampling Done Right: Correcting Bias from Size Imbalance and Dispersion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10483)
*Walid Bendada,Guillaume Salha-Galvan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出两级softmax（2LS）采样虽能实现次线性采样，但因忽略簇规模不平衡与簇内相似度离散度而产生系统性采样偏差；提出S-2LS与SD-2LS两种校正方法，以极小甚至零额外开销获得可证明更优的softmax近似，并在五个大规模数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: softmax采样是机器学习的基础操作，但其线性复杂度使其在大规模场景下难以进行精确采样。2LS采样通过"先选簇、再选簇内项"实现次线性采样，被广泛采用，但作者发现其存在此前未被识别的系统性采样偏差。

Method: 分析2LS偏差来源：簇权重错配，源自忽略（1）簇规模不平衡、（2）簇内相似度离散度。据此提出两种校正采样方法：Size-Corrected 2LS（S-2LS）仅校正簇规模；Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS（SD-2LS）同时校正簇规模与簇内离散度。两种方法在计算开销上可忽略不计或几乎为零。

Result: 在五个大规模数据集上的深入实验验证了所提方法具有更优的采样性质，且提供了可证明更好的softmax近似（provably better softmax approximations）。

Conclusion: 2LS存在由簇规模不平衡和簇内相似度离散度导致的系统性采样偏差；S-2LS与SD-2LS能有效校正这些偏差且开销极小。作者建议未来工作中一致使用这两种方法替代标准2LS。

Abstract: Sampling from a softmax distribution is a fundamental operation in machine learning, but its linear complexity in the number of items makes exact sampling impractical at scale. Two-level softmax (2LS) sampling is a popular alternative enabling sublinear-time sampling. Assuming items are partitioned into clusters, 2LS first samples a cluster and then an item within it. In this paper, we show that, despite its advantages, 2LS introduces systematic and undesirable sampling biases, which arise from misweighting clusters by ignoring both cluster size imbalance and intra-cluster similarity dispersion. We propose two sampling methods, Size-Corrected 2LS (S-2LS) and Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS (SD-2LS), which correct these biases and provide provably better softmax approximations with negligible to non-existent computational overhead. In-depth experiments on five large-scale datasets validate the improved sampling properties of our methods. We recommend their consistent use in place of standard 2LS in future work.

</details>


### [447] [Oracle-Efficient and Parameter-Free Agnostic Smoothed Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10499)
*Sasha Voitovych,Adam Block,Alexander Rakhlin,Abhishek Shetty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究平滑在线学习（smoothed online learning），提出首个在不可知（agnostic）设定下、无需知晓基测度 μ 的 oracle 高效算法，基于 Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader，参数自由，达到 $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/\sigma})$ 遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习虽通用性强，但完全对抗设定带来显著统计与计算障碍。平滑在线学习通过假设每个协变量的条件分布相对于固定基测度 μ 的密度不超过 $1/\sigma$，在对抗与随机设定之间取得折中，兼具经典学习的统计与计算保证以及在线学习的灵活性。然而现有 oracle 高效算法需满足：(i) 对基测度 μ 有采样访问权限，或 (ii) 标签能被固定假设完美预测。这两个假设限制了算法适用性。相比之下，统计学习中的 ERM 在不可知设定下无需任何数据分布知识即可高效学习。因此本文旨在消除这两个假设。

Method: 提出基于 Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader 的算法，在不可知设定下无需知晓 μ。该算法为参数自由型：不需知道 μ、平滑参数 σ 或时间跨度 T。每轮仅需一次对 ERM oracle 的调用。为建立遗憾界，论文引入了若干具有独立价值的新技术。

Result: 证明上述两个假设均非必要，给出首个在不可知设定下无需 μ 知识即达到次线性遗憾的 oracle 高效算法。对于 VC 维为 d 的二分类问题，遗憾界为 $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/\sigma})$，在 $\sqrt{d}$ 因子内达到最优。

Conclusion: 论文表明平滑在线学习可在不可知设定下实现 oracle 高效学习，无需 μ 的采样访问或完美预测假设，达到近乎最优的遗憾界，且算法参数自由，并贡献了若干可能具独立意义的新技术。

Abstract: Online learning is an attractive framework in many domains because it permits well-defined learning even when data are dependent or chosen adversarially. This generality, however, comes at a steep price, introducing significant statistical and computational barriers. Recently, smoothed online learning has emerged as a promising framework that interpolates between the fully adversarial and fully stochastic settings by assuming that the conditional law of each covariate has density at most $1/σ$ with respect to some fixed base measure $μ$, and it is known to match the statistical and computational guarantees of classical learning while still allowing for much of the flexibility of online learning. However, existing oracle-efficient algorithms require either (i) sampling access to the base measure $μ$ or (ii) labels that are perfectly predicted by a fixed hypothesis. Both assumptions limit the applicability of these algorithms, in contrast to statistical learning, where empirical risk minimization (ERM) learns efficiently in the agnostic setting without any knowledge of the data distribution. We show that neither assumption is necessary, giving the first oracle-efficient algorithm that achieves sublinear regret in the agnostic setting without knowledge of $μ$. Our algorithm, based on Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader, is parameter-free: it requires no knowledge of $μ$, the smoothing parameter $σ$, or the horizon $T$, and it achieves regret $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/σ})$ for binary classes of VC dimension $d$ with a single call to an ERM oracle per round, which is optimal up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor. En route to establishing the regret bound, we introduce several new techniques that may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [448] [Why Forget-Only Unlearning Needs Memorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10519)
*Luka Radić,Vikrant Singhal,Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"仅遗忘"式机器遗忘（forget-only unlearning）：删除算法只拿到已训练模型和待遗忘样本，没有保留数据或额外训练信息。作者证明其可行性取决于学习算法（不同数据集可产生相同模型但删除后需不同输出），据此给出与重训练匹配精度的下界；并刻画成功时算法必须记忆的信息量下界，对简单阈值学习器而言该信息量可达整个数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘要求删除算法输出接近"从零重训练（去掉遗忘样本）"的结果。现实中最受限的场景是forget-only：只有训练好的模型与待遗忘样本，既无保留数据也无训练过程信息。作者要回答两个核心问题：(1) forget-only unlearning 是否总是可行；(2) 当它成功时，算法必须对训练数据记忆什么。

Method: 1) 构造性论证：展示不同数据集可产生完全相同的训练模型，但在删除同样的样本后需要截然不同的输出，据此说明可行性依赖于具体学习算法；2) 基于该观察推导 unlearning 输出与重训练结果匹配精度的下界，并对若干标准学习算法进行实例化；3) 进一步推导算法为应对任意删除请求所必须记忆的训练数据信息量下界，以简单阈值学习器为样例分析。

Result: 可行性并非总能保证，取决于学习算法；给出了匹配重训练的精度下界（对多种标准算法实例化）。同时给出记忆量下界：对简单阈值学习器，处理任意删除请求所需信息可多达整个数据集，而普通训练仅保留一个边界点。

Conclusion: 普通学习过程中被丢弃的信息，可能在后续删除时被需要；因此面向forget-only unlearning设计的模型，可能需要比标准训练保留更多信息。

Abstract: Machine unlearning asks for a deletion algorithm whose output is close to retraining from scratch without the selected forget examples. In this work, we study forget-only unlearning, where the deletion algorithm receives only the trained model and the examples to forget, with no retained data or extra training information. We ask whether forget-only unlearning is always possible. We first show that this depends on the learning method: different datasets can produce the same trained model but require very different outputs after the same examples are removed. Using this observation, we derive lower bounds on how accurately unlearning can match retraining and instantiate them for several standard learning algorithms. We then ask what must be true when forget-only unlearning succeeds. To this end, we derive lower bounds on what an algorithm must memorize about the training data to handle arbitrary deletion requests. For simple threshold learners, the required information can be as large as the entire dataset, even though ordinary training keeps only one boundary point. Overall, our results show that information discarded during ordinary learning may be needed later for deletion, so models designed for forget-only unlearning may need to retain more information than standard training does.

</details>


### [449] [Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10536)
*Saif Punjwani,Micah Goldblum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Exploration-Distillation（ExpDis）框架，将探索与优化解耦：用带新颖性奖励的探索策略产生轨迹，经正确性与质量过滤后蒸馏到独立的学生策略，并在多轮中交替探索与优化。在7个数学推理基准、2个模型家族上，同等墙钟预算下优于 DAPO，并展现更好的 pass@k 扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
